hk3gtl.machine.liquid_honkai_fractionati: Separates liquid Honkai energy into crude liquid, mother liquor and analysis reagent.
Uses extractants, filters and other process materials; separation produces effluent and impurities.
Also supports process-fluid regeneration and separation of industrial waste.
hk3gtl.machine.liquid_honkai_stabilizati: Processes crude Honkai liquid into stabilized liquid Honkai energy and Honkai crystals.
Requires stabilization medium, coolant and the relevant process materials.
Spent stabilization medium and hot coolant require recovery; replenish materials lost during recycling.
hk3gtl.machine.stabilization_medium_rege: Regenerates stabilization medium, analysis reagent, coolant and other process fluids.
Recovery consumes power and treatment materials, leaving unrecoverable effluent and residue.
Regeneration incurs losses; replenish fresh medium regularly.
hk3gtl.machine.i01_honkai_collection_tow: Extracts liquid Honkai energy from air, supporting initial sampling and efficient collection.
Initial sampling consumes 1,000,000 mB of liquid air to produce 100 mB of liquid Honkai energy.
Efficient collection requires the corresponding research; detectors, reference samples and configured circuits are not consumed.
hk3gtl.machine.i02_spectrum_analysis_arr: Analyzes Honkai samples, characterizes materials and examines circuit samples.
Initial spectrum analysis consumes the sample and spectral calibration films; the sensor is not consumed.
Set the circuit as shown in JEI. For one specific experiment, insert only its specimens.
hk3gtl.research.industrial_recorded: Recorded experiment evidence for %s. Check research requirements at the institute.
hk3gtl.machine.liquid_line.waiting_outpu: Waiting for output space, the owner or research requirements; this batch is retained.
hk3gtl.machine.honkai_fuel_blending_plan: Blends stabilized liquid Honkai energy and fuel matrix into liquid Honkai fuel.
Also blends resonantly activated fuel; residual fluids require separate recovery.
hk3gtl.machine.honkai_detector_calibrati: Performs precision detector calibration and produces calibration reports.
Returns the original detector after calibration; reports are used for subsequent detector upgrades.
hk3gtl.machine.imitation_core_crystalliz: Grows Honkai crystal seeds, crystallizes imitation cores and reconstructs related materials.
Supply the seeds, reactants and process fluids specified by the recipe; crystal products are used in further manufacturing.
hk3gtl.machine.honkai_fuel_concentration: Concentrates Honkai fuel and processes stable crystals and compressed cores.
Provides refined feedstock for concentrated and advanced fuels.

hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.finished: This is where this path ends. What else would you like to see?
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.01: "Nuclear power, easy! So this is how you announced that the large Honkai reactor was inaugurated? Well, that, Ben Herrscher, will keep the tarts for you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.02: The control room was filled with a first line of light, the plant restored power, and you've been discussing where to build the second one.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.03: As for the operating manual, under a glass for the celebration, there was already a platinum reactor moving. What could be worth a page over? ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.04: Then, when one hand touched the wrong place, the cooling condition that was supposed to be confirmed first wasn't confirmed.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.05: You started laughing at the pointers, you said it was a small problem; when the laughs stopped, the alarm had already been ringing for you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.06: Someone jumped to the console, someone ran for the exit and hung it in the recorder.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.07: The core finally blew up the tatter, and you thought you'd shut the sun down.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.08: The plant is followed by a storage station, followed by the city's expanding energy hub, which drags everything that connects you into flames.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.09: Ben Herrscher didn't even have time to see the last recording of the reactor's name, civilization -- it started with confidence, behind it was all murmurs.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.0.10: Nuclear power, easy? Well, I'll put that on the ruins and at least the later will know how sure you were.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.01: This dry civilization, not the first to divide the land, is a very small phrase: "The one you use, too? ”☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.02: A steamman can't look down on a man who uses magic, a man who laughs at a man who lays a cable and how to open a warehouse door, enough for them to argue all day.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.03: At first they just argued about their tools, and then what they liked became a flag, and what they didn't like was a crime; they finally didn't have to look at what they were doing.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.04: A man comes out with a new machine, not asking questions, but checking whose side he's on. With whose design? Why do you have to go out with those people? ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.05: The bridge was broken because the other side of the bridge had been cut off, because it would have been a very careful distribution of electric cables, even for common heating.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.06: They call every destruction a victory, put the wrecks in the square, wait for their comrades to drink the city a little less each day and celebrate more than the day.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.07: Some people tried to persuade them to fix it together, and they found out on both sides that the man was trying to get a hold of you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.08: The war lasted for a long time, and every factory could find the man to hate.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.09: When Ben Herrscher looks over here, there's no one left but a few of them, keeping the lights out and continuing to prove that their light is noble.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.1.10: Who the hell did you win? Speak louder, Ben Herrscher.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.01: You've been studying in the lab for a long time, and you've finally drawn a conclusion to one of your provocations and sent it to the Queen.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.02: So the sky darkened and there was no clouds, no night screens -- just a figure larger than all your measurements, looking down at this civilization.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.03: You look up, you don't see the highest observation tower in the sky above her head.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.04: The alarms were launched throughout the mainland fleet, shielded. All the weapons that were supposed to last were pushed onto the launch pad at the same moment.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.05: And this time, you did do everything in your power to pull those cannons out of her arm and look at it from the ground as if they were enough to light up the stars of the night sky.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.06: But she's only slightly missed the end of the migraines, and there's not even a trace that deserves to be identified.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.07: "That's it? "The Queen reaches out, and his thumbs and index finger are slowly coming near you to see the shadows of two horizons covering the horizon, coming together from both sides of civilization.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.08: The fleet tried to break out of the finger, and the city sent its last energy into the shield.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.09: Without the towers and ships that you think are sharp enough to make a little crumb from her fingertips.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.2.10: Ben Herrscher remembers that civilization you fought for... and let me think, left hand or right hand? ☆
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.01: "Honkai? "When you hear the word, it's a rather interesting expression. It's not fear. It's not in the catalogue of studies.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.02: You're going to take another complete technological road, where the ore is torn apart, and the elements are to be re-organised, and the giant machine is to rise up and finally create the heart of the universe.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.03: Later, artificial stars lit you up in front of the factory, talking about energy supply, expansion, and how much more material is needed to move on.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.04: And then, you set out to create dimensions that used to exhaust the entire production line as if it was no longer worth counting.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.05: Ben Herrscher admits that these achievements have not been facilitated by Honkai, and you have also come to places where many civilizations can't even think of names.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.06: But you didn't have a location for Honkai, and you didn't touch it, so you thought the whole road didn't have to answer it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.07: The first thing you saw when Herrscher arrived was that your most proud technocratic shell didn't stop understanding, and the latching didn't hide the principle.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.08: The heart of the universe has been broken, and man-made stars have fallen to the other side of your hands so that you think you've crossed the creative dimension of the finish line, and you can't isolate the ruins from them.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.09: You didn't go far enough, you were nothing but enemies on the map, and you ended up walking into the map.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.3.10: It's a shame to be able to deliver this interview so beautifully, but the last one, Herrscher, didn't follow your familiar formula.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.01: This leaves Herrscher to spend a little more time on an empty machine bed, without a cable full of ground cables, even the air seems quieter.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.02: You let the flowers gather their strength, then you can direct it to where they need to be supplied.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.03: On the other side, blood drops into the altar and you don't pretend it's an unrequited gift, a price paid and a power gained.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.04: The flow of spirits between the forest lands is carefully guided by you to look after each other's trees, land and homes.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.05: And even more strange voodoo pills, rituals and strangers who seem to be refusing to obey the same rules, yet you find a way to get along.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.06: The wounds are healing, planting the means to transport, guard, travel and wait for a steel factory to give you answers.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.07: Ben Herrscher thought he'd see a bunch of people who only dared to pray to the unknown, and you'd remember it better than many engineers.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.08: When the lights in the city turned on, the garden was still a garden, and the forest was still the strength of the forest that grew in life without crowding it into the corner.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.09: As for whether this will reach the end of the line Ben Herrscher has not yet taken this leaf and kept it long enough to taste it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.4.10: I'm just saying that you use these little tricks pretty good enough for me to look at them again.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.01: The beginning of this branch is when you get a box that says there's nothing left to open, and even the sky is about to be filled with roads inside.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.02: On the left is the factory, on the right is magic, there's a remnant in the ground, and you just learned the first page, and ten new books have been opened.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.03: You want to be a machine? You want to have a garden first? Or can you want to drop the garden and go to another dimension? The door was for you.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.04: Such tolerance is tempting for you to find a force you've never used every day, and every path is like saying, "Come here, something really interesting lies ahead."
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.05: So the warehouse started to pile up with a first half set of rituals, an array of transmission networks, a power-only factory and a backpack for the next launch.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.06: And sometimes you ask, "What is the answer to what?" And the person who does it can't stop opening a new door.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.07: Ben Herrscher saw someone get lost in this maze, and he saw someone pick a corner and slowly build their own city.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.08: The same box, the two endings, it doesn't make a choice for the former, nor does it stop the latter from stopping.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.09: You have so many possibilities, it's a happy thing to say when you say goodbye.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.5.10: Pick one for Ben Herrscher, see what's in the box. I saw it; you're going to take something out of it, and it's your turn to answer the question.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.01: Listen, it's easy to recognize that the sound of the current line has never stopped.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.02: It took you a long time for the ore to go into storage, the raw materials to be sorted out, the formula to line up, and finally let every machine know what it has to do.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.03: Then, one day, you go online, open up the terminal, click on what you need, and then you turn on that newly installed machine.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.04: There's enough raw materials, the power is steady, and there's no blockage on the way, so I can't find anything you need to do.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.05: So you jump from this to that one, and you jump back to this one.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.06: Jumping on the machine, jumping on the machine, jumping on the machine, jumping on the machine, jumping on and off Ben Herrscher thought it was some kind of industrial ritual that had to be done.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.07: When you finally stop, the numbers in the terminals are up a little bit, so we can make another order and tell our people that today's going well.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.08: You're off the water stream and you've kept your promise. There's not even a trace of your busy work on the shell that was just stepped on.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.09: It's only Ben Herrscher who has the ability to hand over such a complex job to the machine.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.6.10: What's next order for? If you still have to answer more orders, keep dancing.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.01: In this branch, the first tool to reach far away is a thick book on the cover that tells you real knowledge hasn't started yet.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.02: You'll learn to identify the material, then you'll learn how to placate a pattern.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.03: Then the new magic, the new altar, and the new bond force demand that you learn its own language and not be subdued by a mighty spell.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.04: Some people are good at calling, others study the border and others write countless failures in pages, finally turning a magic trick around their own meanings.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.05: The argument in the city is also good to hear where a line should be drawn, what should be placed in the center.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.06: But by night, a light will shine from every corner of the world on something you've learned with your own hands.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.07: Is this power at any cost? Of course, those who read the last page know that someone who skips a warning will be able to fill this lesson from somewhere else.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.08: Ben Herrscher doesn't require every civilization to put the answer in its shell, so you can read what you call it, and then you're ready to turn the book over.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.09: Just because the spell is long enough, don't think you've understood it between recitation and domination.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.7.10: Come on, let's go back to the next page. What do we write? If you're finally leaving your own words, Ben Herrscher might read it in person.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.8.01: There's hardly anyone else in the same place who would have lived behind the horizon for too long.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.8.02: The first relic appeared in the forest, and you put fire on it, dragged out with a backpack full of stuff and thought you heard the world wave.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.8.03: Then high towers, dungeons, strange crowds, and the edge of the gate map to another sky, there's always a blank, waiting to be filled with feet.

hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.24.08: What can be deleted is the world that has been preserved, not everything that's happened, but the way you learn to speak to your peers, not in the same document.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.24.09: There may be a new beginning, and perhaps there's no need to force yourself to close the door forever in order not to prove that it was worth it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.24.10: Ben Herrscher saw that confirmation of how to get out of the door.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.01: Last look at a leaf that doesn't have to apply for material from the warehouse, you reach out your hand, and the diamonds you want are in your hand; lift up, and the sky doesn't ask you to build a machine.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.02: You didn't start with the wood, you didn't prepare a long production line for the first lamp.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.03: The castle can hang in the clouds, the ship can cross the ridge, and the whole river can switch to another arc for what you want.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.04: Some people say it's so easy to come, and there's nothing else to do about it, Herrscher, looking at the empty space, but I think they haven't really thought about what they're building.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.05: The material is no longer in your way, but the sizes, shapes and thoughts still require you to decide for yourself why this window should open here without a formula.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.06: You've tried many times to thin the wall too thick, move the towers away and reset half the sky for a long look.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.07: These changes will not be fully remembered by a list of materials, but when you finally get to the ground and see the finished product, you know it's different from what it was at first.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.08: Ben Herrscher doesn't need you to suffer enough to admit that if you build something beautiful, you can only prove value on a scarce basis and imagine being locked up for too long.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.09: Here, the world doesn't push you to graduate, nor does it have a number that says enough for you to go on, stop, or invite someone else to see it.
hk3gtl.dialogue.if_archive.if.25.10: Do it, builder. Let Ben Herrscher see what the sky looks like when you don't have to bow your head for material.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.title: First letter: Otto's first letter
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.1: Allow me to extend my greetings across the barriers between the worlds.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.2: I'm Otto Abocalis, Archbishop of "Sicksal". In our world, this organization has long been committed to fighting a scourge called “Honkai”.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.3: I have the privilege of seeing your world with the second God's key left by the former civilization — a multiplication of thousands. Frankly, a civilization that does not depend on Honkai energy but can bring industrial and energy technology to this end deserves the presence of any researcher.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.4: However, while appreciating these achievements, I have also noted some familiar signs.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.5: An energy that has not yet been recognized by you is dispersing in your world. It may not have entered your energy classification, or it may have been recorded as some difficult to interpret measurement deviations. But in our world, it has a clear name:
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.7: Based on our observational experience, these indications suggest that your civilization is likely to have drawn attention to the “end-of-the-art”.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.8: I know that for those who first received cross-border correspondence, this sounds like a well-prepared intimidation. Therefore, I attach to my letter a basic observation that includes the identifiers of Honkai energy and methods for extracting trace samples from large amounts of air. You can check and decide whether or not to continue reading my proposal.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.9: In our history, Honkai was accompanied by the development of civilization. The eroded humans, the alien shape known as the Honkai beast, and the “Herrscher” with extraordinary power have all taught us a painful lesson.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.1: But I must admit that your world is not ours.

The catastrophes that we have experienced do not necessarily come to you in the same way. And the observations that can be made across thousands are not enough for me to make all of your judgements. However, before the differences are identified, it is always more prudent to know what has been learned than to be unprepared for unknowns.

It is also worth noting that Honkai energy is not the only side of destruction. We have also tried to understand, restrain and use it. For a civilization such as yours, with its mature industrial base, it may mean danger or an undiscovered technological path.
That's why I wrote this letter.

Schicksal has a long-term exposure to the knowledge accumulated by Honkai; you have a very different path to technological development than we do. I hope that we can begin with a limited exchange of information, develop an understanding of each other and discuss more specific research and trade cooperation in due course.
In particular, I am very interested in your energy engineering and materials processes, as well as in the computing capacity that underpins these results.

Of course, trust cannot be delivered with a letter. I will not ask you to hand over your technology or make a long-term commitment when you don't know about Schicksal. We can well determine a small matter of value to both sides before we see whether the next step is worth continuing.
The information is accompanied by no conditions for acceptance of cooperation. Whatever your responses, I suggest you take a closer look at your world.

As for the time that has elapsed since the arrival of this letter, I am afraid you will not be able to use your clocks as a simple calculation. Time in different worlds does not always move at the same pace.
I look forward to your responses.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A01.line.2: May your development never be held hostage to God.
Attached information: Honkai energy Basic Observation Information
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.title: Second: Playback - Agree to work together
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.1: Your letter and accompanying information have been received.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.2: It is equally important for us to be able to connect with civilizations in another world. Thank you for your offer to provide information on Honkai energy. This information provides us with a direction that we have not previously considered, and we will study it carefully and independently validate it.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.3: We will not be reckless about what you describe as a disaster. But we also agree with your judgement that the two worlds are different, that what happens in your world is likely to happen here again and requires further observation and factual answers.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.4: After consideration, we would like to accept your invitation to cooperate and establish an initial exchange with Schicksal.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.5: We hope to start with information that can be verified by both sides and clear research issues. For subsequent technical exchanges, calculation of assistance or trade in goods, the content and terms can be agreed upon on a case-by-case basis after understanding each other.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.6: Our civilization is willing to learn and share the fruits worth exchanging. But any cooperation should be based on voluntary, reciprocal and respect for ownership. Arrangements involving the interests of both parties need to be expressly agreed upon by both parties.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.7: Your experience with Honkai may help us to make less of a turn, and the industries that we have developed on our own may also provide you with different ideas.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.8: We would like to know the first cooperation you have proposed.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.9: It is hoped that this communication across the world will be the beginning of a valuable exchange.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A02.line.1:
The leader of a different civilization.

On behalf of our civilization, greeting.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.title: Third: Playlist Reply - Not Agreed to Cooperate
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.1: Your letter and accompanying information have been received.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.2: It is equally important for us to be able to connect with civilizations in another world. Thank you for your offer to provide information on Honkai energy. This information provides us with a direction that we have not previously considered, and we will study it carefully and independently validate it.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.3: We will not be reckless about what you describe as a disaster. But we also agree with your judgement that the two worlds are different, that what happens in your world is likely to happen here again and requires further observation and factual answers.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.4: Having considered this, we have decided not to accept this invitation for cooperation.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.5: At the moment, we still know too little about Schicksal, your world and the implications this cooperation can have. Until those issues are fully recognized, we will not assume the obligations that are unclear on behalf of our own civilization, nor will we venture into exchanges of technology or resources.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.6: We note that you have indicated that the information accompanying this letter is not conditional on cooperation. We are grateful for this goodwill and will study Honkai energy in our own way, judging its meaning to our world.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.7: This decision is not animosity towards you or Schicksal, but rather a position we take in the face of unknown circumstances. We need our own judgement and responsibility for the direction of civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.8: Thank you for your letter and for your willingness to share with us the experiences of another world.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.9: May the civilization of both sides find a way forward.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A03.line.1:
The leader of a different civilization.

On behalf of our civilization, greeting.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.title: Honkai energy Basic Observation Information
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.0: To researchers in charge of preliminary observations:
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.1: You have not named it, and that does not mean that it will not exist until today. Your factories are still operating as usual and familiar instruments do not necessarily alert. A set of equipment that is manufactured only for known targets can easily be viewed as unrelated to the target.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.2: Therefore, the first step should be to add a different eye to your collection equipment.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.3: Your existing sensors, transmitters, and MAX-tier circuits can already serve as the basis for a prototype detector. It need not be precise at first; even helping collection equipment identify targets makes it worth building. Fine calibration can wait until you have samples to analyze.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.4: I suggest that this test be kept in the collection tower. There are traceable signals in the air, but they are too low and ordinary readings can easily drown them. The detector is responsible for identifying the target; there is a sufficient amount of air that really needs to be delivered into the equipment.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.5: First, you use the vacuum refrigeration equipment you already have to liquidate air and then send a large amount of liquid air into the collection towers. Liquefied, condensed and extracted should be the work of your first experiment in sequence. Please also fill the tower with fluid input and output, leaving room for the collection of that small liquid.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.6: A test-type Honkai energy detector guides the collection and requires no programmable circuits to consume 1,000,000 mB liquid air in order to obtain 100 mB liquid Honkai energy. The detectors are not depleted and can continue to be used. The metals, the guidance lines and the glass are the materials that make the instruments; the energy you extract is in the air.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.7: When the first liquid enters the collection container, please keep it with the records of this operation. It is enough for your researchers to start serious discussions about a new energy; more needs to be identified as to its nature.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.8: The next work will be with your familiar canneries and bottles. A properly sealed analytical sample is more suitable for transport to the laboratory than an unknown liquid that hastily accessed the main production line. When doing spectroscopy analysis, do not forget to put paper on the device — the first seen result is worth keeping a retrievable record.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.9: From aeroliquidation, trace extraction to sealing and spectroscopy analysis, you will gradually get evidence from your own world. Once calibration has been completed, a first-stage liquid detector has been made and HBV power is available, liquidation and extraction can be integrated into the tower: 2400 mB liquid Honkai energy obtained directly from 1,000,000mB ordinary air, in conjunction with four reusable reference samples and 4 series circuits. Better processes should gradually integrate old and complex steps.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A04.line.1: If you want to talk to Schicksal, I'm looking forward to reading these records. If you choose independent research, this path can also be taken by yourselves.
Please start with that little liquid.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.title: First proposal
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.2: Since my last letter, something has happened here. However, since there is no reliable correspondence between the clocks on both sides, I think it would be better for us not to measure each other's good faith by the length of the wait.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.3: I have carefully read your description of the cooperation boundary. Voluntary, reciprocal and unequivocal consent — I have no objection. These conditions can be carefully written to indicate that you are already considering how a relationship should be maintained, not just how it should begin.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.4: I propose, then, to limit the first cooperation to one basic observation.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.5: When your collection towers obtain the first liquid and send sealed samples into a spectroscopy analysis device, you can provide Schicksal with a summary of your own self-validation observations: how the samples were obtained, what was processed and what results were left behind. Please maintain the records of each collection and analysis so that we do not misperceive the original nature of the sample of changes in processing.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.6: You do not have to hand over the factory layout, complete equipment drawings or the core design of energy systems, and you do not need to send ununderstood samples to another world. For this step, a record describing the methodology and results is sufficient.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.7: In exchange, I will give a comparative view of the record: what is close to what we have seen, what is not well-founded and what should be the top priority for the next observation.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.8: You can also discuss only one phenomenon of assured disclosure. If certain information relates to technologies you do not wish to disclose, please indicate them directly. I would prefer to receive a report that clearly indicates the borders than to hide the key conditions in a seemingly complete report.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.9: Of course, I do not want nothing about it.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A05.line.1: You've built a fairly mature industrial system before you get to Honkai energy. Understanding how such a civilization can recognize and deal with it is in itself a valuable gain for Schicksal. Especially when your results are not consistent with our experience.

If you think this is acceptable, we will take that as our first cooperation. If there are any adjustments, please also write back. There is no need to promise a condition of doubt in order to maintain courtesy.
It is hoped that, by the time of the next communication, we will have one fact on the table that we can discuss together.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.title: Keep Distance
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.2: Refusal to assume the duty of cooperation while not yet known about Schicksal is an understandable option. I will not interpret it as hostile, nor do I intend to change the language in the next letter and ask you to make a similar commitment.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.3: The observations provided in the previous letter are still available for your own use. As I have already said, it is not conditional on cooperation; this sentence will not be changed because the letter of reply does not meet my expectations.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.4: However, allow me to correct a possible misunderstanding: I am willing to provide information that does not mean that Schicksal has no purpose of his own. I am interested in your industrial technology, a civilization that is still on the brink of Honkai and which deserves our continued understanding.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.5: You are willing to separate your judgement from my proposal, which is good. But please apply the same caution to the experiment. It is not because the information comes from me that I accept it in its entirety, nor because of the rejection of my invitation to prove that every word in the information is wrong.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.6: Instruments don't care if we work together. It leaves a record that still needs to be carefully explained.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.7: I won't ask you to submit your observations. Should you be willing to exchange views on a specific issue at a later stage, the terms of reference could be clarified in your letter. That would be a new negotiation and would not be seen as a follow-up to today's invitation.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.8: If there is no such need, this communication will be completed.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A06.line.9: May the next time you look at your world, you will see it better than today.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.title: First-time observations against views
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.1: I've read the observations you sent.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.2: From the collection tower to the encapsulation of samples and the completion of spectral analysis, you have turned the initial guess into an open-ended fact. Now, finally, we don't have to focus on the description in my letter.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.3: As far as this preliminary record is concerned, I think there's a basis for identifying the abnormal ingredients you caught as Honkai energy. It is consistent with what we know. However, this judgement does not provide assurance for the whole collection of liquids. Not all components of the liquid you've recovered are worth sending into the next device.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.4: Next, it would be more valuable than expanding the scale of collection to identify what should remain and what needs to be separated.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.5: You are certainly not new to the idea of division. By the time your researchers complete their analysis of this spectral record, you can put the next job on liquid separation. When preparing to separate the equipment, attention is paid to the orientation crystal matrix in addition to carbon and filter cores. These things look far less visible than a new reactor, but they make it possible to keep the work behind us from taking many turns.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.6: Packagings are left for different production logistics, as well as for impurities and residues. In particular, do not rush to remove the liquid from the mother - without entering the main product, it is not necessarily lost. When you further understand its composition, some of these things can also be helpers in follow-up.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.7: The crude liquid that is separated is not yet a fuel that can be put into direct use. Separation, stability and redeployment are several tasks that need to be done separately. If they are considered to be the same, sooner or later the production line will point out this mistake for us.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.8: These are my comments on the first record. It helps you to determine the way forward that is worth trying; a process that really suits your equipment will still have to be built by your own researchers.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.9: As for what Schicksal has learned from this exchange, I think it should be clear.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A07.line.1: You have proved that the original industrial base is sufficient to support preliminary research into this strange energy. This is more convincing than a warm pledge of future cooperation. I would like to continue to know how you will bring it into production and look forward to seeing where you come up with different answers from us.
Please keep this first record. And when your factory actually starts using Honkai energy, it reminds you that this was all the first time that it was just a small piece of liquid from the tower.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.title: About your stabilization test.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.0: To the head of research who sent Honkai energy to industrial production lines:
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.2: We have received a test brief from you. First of all, the conclusion that it is possible to treat the initial collection of liquids into a stable product deserves congratulations.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.3: Then read this letter, too, for those of you who are in charge of the maintenance.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.4: I don't have your complete equipment and I don't know where every pipe in the factory goes. But since you intend to continue expanding production, there are a few things that it would be better to think about now.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.5: Where were the used media when the stabilizers sent out their first products? Where's the coolant? If your answer is just "to load the can next to you first," then draw out the course behind it while it's still empty.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.6: Don't get me wrong, of course it's for temporary storage. The real problem is that when the production line expands tenfold, those things that were supposed to be “later” are found ten times more together.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.7: Separated the used medium from different residues, leaving access to the regenerative device. The reusable parts have to be recovered and the unserviceable parts have to be found. Even when recycling is already in operation, the replenishment of fresh media and consumables cannot be stopped.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.8: Also, the word “fuel” should not be placed early because of a steady liquid. What matrix, crystallization and reference samples are needed for the deployment to be cleared by the person responsible for the process. The same results continue to be obtained at the laboratory, with a lot of work in place.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.9: Now that your original industrial base has reached this level, I think it's not hard to understand.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.1: As for why we contacted you — you showed us a technical route worth studying. Instead of waiting until both sides have built the factory to each other's incomprehensible, I would rather start exchanging some engineering judgments now.

The design of the entire plant does not need to be handed over first. Just pick a problem you'd like to open up and face. If there is no intention to communicate for the time being, these reminders are not charged.
Take care of the equipment. There will be opportunities to discuss the scale it can achieve.

Dr. Tesla was only going to write a short greeting. When she saw the results of stabilization in the briefing, she began to think about how you would set up the pipeline, and that was what I had to say.
The judgement we can make is limited to the information that you have made public. With regard to equipment and studies that have not yet been displayed, we do not assume that we already know.

If you wish to continue your exchanges, please keep inputs, products and the movement of the latter medium in the next record. Such a record would allow us to know why a process can last, and not just how successful it has been.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A08.line.2:
Dr. Einstein and Dr. Tesla
Anti-Entropy
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.title: About the material carrying it.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.0: To the leaders of different civilizations:
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.2: We've read your public stabilization test records. You have been able to leave a strange energy at your disposal. Next, when more sophisticated equipment begins to operate around it, the material that carries them becomes a problem.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.3: Maybe you'll try a thicker shell, a tighter isolation. These approaches are useful. But we suggest that you consider another course of material.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.5: Don't be led by that name to an ordinary furnace. Its key lies in a smaller scale: its ability to receive instructions, its ability to co-organize nanomodules and its ability to restructure itself.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.6: If you decide to study it, you can start with precursor materials and nanokiss. When the assembled units can be controlled, discussions can then take place on how to make them a stable group. A group of units that have not been programmed, even if in sufficient quantities, will not become eligible material on their own.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.7: There is also a need to consider Honkai resistance before they can be combined. Otherwise, you might not have been able to carry the material you're trying to use for Honkai energy.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.8: With regard to the crudes obtained in their first form, attention is drawn to the structural deficiencies left by it. Reconstructing the fire and subsequent processing is worth taking over your design. Don't rush the first piece into the most important equipment.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.9: We are willing to provide that direction, because a civilization capable of independently establishing this manufacturing route deserves further engagement.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.A09.line.1: This letter does not ask you to hand over the drawings, nor does it take a decision on your behalf to cooperate. If you wish to respond, please select only one study of the material that you can make public. We will judge the extent to which the next exchange can go further.
If you do not wish to respond, the information will remain with you.
How you deal with the original imperfections will tell us how far you can go before an ambitious plan.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N01.title: Access to basic observational exchange
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N01.line.1: We are ready to engage in this exchange within the parameters that you have proposed.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N01.line.2: The observations will be completed at our own facilities. Once the record is sufficient to describe the sampling and analysis process, we will submit a validated summary and look forward to receiving your promised matching comments.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N01.line.3: This exchange is limited to this observation. Other research materials, equipment design and follow-up cooperation still need to be negotiated separately.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N01.line.4: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N02.title: We don't accept this exchange of information.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N02.line.1: Your offer has been received. We have decided to complete the study independently and do not submit observations this time.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N02.line.2: Contacts previously established may be retained; other specific cooperation will be considered separately upon receipt of a proposal.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N02.line.3: Thank you for explaining the scope and purpose of the exchange.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N02.line.4: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N03.title: Submission of summary of first observations
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N03.line.1: The agreed summary of the first observations is presented in this letter.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N03.line.2: The records contain the results of actual completed sampling, encapsulation and spectral analysis. We're only submitting those parts of the exchange that we expressly agreed to; other designs for the plant are not there.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N03.line.3: Please give your comparative opinion accordingly. Please also indicate that it is currently speculative for judgements which are not sufficiently substantiated.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N03.line.4: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N04.title: Accept your independent research decisions.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N04.line.1: I have received your responses to this proposal.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N04.line.2: Since you wish to complete the study independently, I will not press for the submission of records. The exchange thus concluded that the available observational information was still available to you.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N04.line.3: If you are willing to revisit a specific issue at a later date, you can raise it directly. We will communicate to the extent clearly agreed at that time, without considering today's refusal as a debt to be repaid.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N05.title: Call me again, Schicksal.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N05.line.1: We would like to revisit the previous exchange of basic observations.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N05.line.2: The previous rejection was a decision taken at that time. Now, we would like to know if this subject can be reopened with a clearly defined range of information.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N05.line.3: This letter is accompanied by no research. Please confirm the terms of exchange before we decide whether or not to submit the record.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N05.line.4: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N06.title: Renegotiate the exchange of observations
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N06.line.1: I am pleased that you are willing to discuss it again.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N06.line.2: We can still start with a basic observations summary: you decide on publicly available sampling and analytical records, and I will provide a comparison of these records. Complete equipment design is not required.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N06.line.3: If you accept this scope, then the record will be sufficient. The previous refusal did not have to be withdrawn; this consent was also applicable only to the present communication.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N07.title: Accept Anti-Entropy Project Exchange
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N07.line.1: Letters received. We are willing to begin by sharing input and output records from the stabilization process.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N07.line.2: We'll sort out the actual batch and explain where we're going with the rear media. The recovery process, which is not yet operational, will be properly identified and will not be presented as a result.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N07.line.3: Communication is limited to this process and does not include other facilities or communications with third parties.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N07.line.4: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N08.title: Not performing the Anti-Entropy Project Exchange
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N08.line.1: Thank you for the reminder. We will retain these proposals, but at this point we have decided to improve our own production lines and hold the exchange of information pending.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N08.line.2: This decision is limited to the current proposal. In the future, we will be in separate contact if there are issues that are suitable for joint discussion.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N08.line.3: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N09.title: Anti-Entropy confirms the range of communication
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N09.line.1: This range can be. Please retain the full batch of inputs and outputs, with an indication of which material is temporarily stored and which have entered the next actual process.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N09.line.2: Part not yet running can be left empty. We need to know what step a production line is now taking before we can discuss the next step.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N09.line.3: Dr. Tesla added that in order to make the report look good, do not delete from the record what was accumulated in the jar.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N10.title: Anti-Entropy in response to this refusal
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N10.line.0: Copy that. Let's get this straight, okay?
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N10.line.1: The preceding reminders can be used as well. One day we will talk about a problem that deserves to be studied together, and then we will make the scope clear.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N10.line.2: There's no need to stop the machine at hand in order to answer this letter.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N11.title: Submission of stabilization batch records
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N11.line.1: (c) Submission of agreed stabilization batch records along with letters.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N11.line.2: The actual inputs and outputs are shown in the annex. For those post-treatment media that have not yet been processed, we maintain their actual status and do not account for the planned recovery as a product acquired.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N11.line.3: Let's start with the results that have already taken place and give you your project advice.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N11.line.4: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N12.title: Anti-Entropy First Project Feedback
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N12.line.1: This record is enough to allow us to begin our discussions.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N12.line.2: Dr. Tesla ' s opinion is that the treatment position of the latter medium and other residues should be fixed before expanding the load of stabilization equipment. Even for the time being, it is necessary to let operators know what they receive on each route.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N12.line.3: The portion that has entered into recovery should continue to be accounted for according to the actual return volume; those still in storage will be retained as material to be processed. Instead of combining the two, it has been completed as a whole.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N12.line.4: This is followed by a comparison of fresh inputs and final outputs over a period of continuous production. The conclusions thus reached would be suitable for use in arranging the expansion.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N12.line.5: This comment is limited to the batches submitted and does not constitute a guarantee of operation for the entire plant.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N12.line.7: Attach: I didn't ask you to reset every machine. Let's start with those canisters that will be filled sooner or later. _Other Organiser
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N13.title: Accepts the exchange of WorldSerpent materials
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N13.line.1: The direction of the material you have presented is worth studying. We are ready to choose an open record for communication once tangible results have been achieved.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N13.line.2: This response confirmed only the subject matter of the material study. It does not involve camp affiliation, nor does it authorize visits to other studies or facilities.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N13.line.3: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N14.title: Reject this WorldSerpent exchange
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N14.line.1: Letters received. We will assess the direction of the material, but there is no exchange of information at this time.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N14.line.2: Please interpret this response as a decision on this proposal. We have not submitted any results of the study, nor have we accepted other agreements.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N14.line.3: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N15.title: WorldSerpent confirms the subject of the material
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N15.line.1: Until you complete the manufacture of a stable Soulium, you can submit your form and re-construct the fire. The actual results of this material are only required and no other design for the plant is required.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N15.line.2: If you have not yet reached this point, you will continue to do your job. We will not write a non-existent sample into the performance record of the communication conditions.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N16.title: World Serpent responds to this refusal.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N16.line.1: This is the end of this exchange. It is up to you to determine the direction that has been provided, and we do not ask for information which has not yet been granted.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N16.line.2: If so, please describe the specific themes you wish to discuss.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N17.title: Submitted Stable Soulium Research Record
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N17.line.1: The attached record of the material shall be limited to the formation and re-construction process, which has actually been completed.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N17.line.2: The results came from our equipment and experiments. Please indicate by this means that your judgement regarding the route of this material does not consider the non-submitted technology to be part of the exchange.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N17.line.3: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N18.title: WorldSerpent Initial Submission Feedback
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N18.line.1: You have put the material in the direction of the actual process. The key thereafter is to keep the different batches in a usable structure, rather than simply keeping the first successful sample.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N18.line.2: Continue to keep a record of the flow of crude material and its equivalent after the fire has receded. Once processed, it should also be possible to trace which batch of materials the component originated. The ability to restructure is worth being included in a more complex design only if it remains viable in the final component.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N18.line.3: This outcome is sufficient to serve as a basis for continued communication. If there is a next exchange, we will propose a separate scope and conditions.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N19.title: Summary of public stabilization results
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N19.line.0: To the researchers who received this information:
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N19.line.1: Our facility has completed its first stabilization in liquid Honkai energy. A validated summary of the results is made publicly available to interested researchers for information on this progress.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N19.line.2: The summary contains only the selected public experimental facts of this time, and does not contain complete plant design, private communications or other unauthorized information.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N19.line.3: If so, please describe the identity, the subject of the study and the scope of the required communication. We will consider the proposals separately.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N19.line.4: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N20.title: The opening of a personal conversation.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N20.line.0: You're making up your own unfinished experience of communication.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N20.line.1: The decisions already taken by the original team will be retained as background. You can read the text and finish this personal exchange, but you can't re-select the team here.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N20.line.2: Retrospect and additional talks will not be repeated with a team award.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N21.title: Pending themes
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N21.line.0: The subject has been retained and no response has yet been sent.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N21.line.1: This could be continued later from the “Pilot pending” at the information centre. Close interface will not be recorded as rejected.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N22.title: Look back at the date.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N22.line.0: This shows the movements that have taken place and the responses that were received at that time.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N22.line.1: Retrospect does not re-transmit messages, change team positions or receive awards again. To re-establish contact, a new theme should be proposed.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N23.title: Reconnect Anti-Entropy
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N23.line.1: We would like to see the resumption of previous stabilization engineering exchanges, which remain limited to actual batches of inputs, products and post-mechanism status.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N23.line.2: If you wish to continue, we will submit the record after confirmation of the scope. The history of the earlier rejection of this proposal need not be rewritten.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N23.line.3: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N24.title: Anti-Entropy responding to contact again
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N24.line.1: Can go on. Please provide a record of the actual batches to the extent indicated in the letter, and it is not necessary to add any hypothetical results to those processes that are not yet operational.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N24.line.2: We'll discuss it on that basis. Other designs and communications are outside the scope of this exchange.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N25.title: Reconnect
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N25.line.1: We would like to revisit the subject of the material that was presented earlier.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N25.line.2: The scope of this exchange is the actual Soulium formation and re-establishment of a fire-release record. Other technologies are still not included. Please confirm whether this scope is accepted.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N25.line.3: The leader of a different civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N26.title: WorldSerpent responding to contact again
hk3gtl.approved.communication.N26.line.1: I'd like to present the records of the materials you have completed. The exchange was carried out to the extent determined by this letter, and the old record of refusal was kept.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-1.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-1.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-1.line.0: Hello, I'm Mei. There's more life here than I thought.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-1.line.1: The machine's voice never stopped, but you didn't build this house just to keep them safe.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-2.title: Herescher of Thunder Mei again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-2.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-2.line.0: Hello again. If there's anything you want to talk about today, you can say it slowly. I'm not here to rush you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-3.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-3.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-3.line.0: If you're preparing a new experiment, think first of all about what is most needed for confirmation. It's better to take every step of the way than to speed it up.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-4.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei... we'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-4.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-4.line.0: Let's get to work. I won't take silence as a rejection because you're not available.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-5.title: Herrscher of Thander Mei...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-5.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-5.line.0: That's all for today. Don't just worry about the care equipment, but take care of yourself.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-6.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-6.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-6.line.0: Do you have a minute to stop and talk? It's okay not to talk about work.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-7.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-7.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-7.line.0: I don't have to worry if I'm too late to see you come out and greet your guests.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-8.title: Herrscher of Thander Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-8.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-8.line.0: Is there a place where you can sit quietly without checking any equipment?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-9.title: Herrscher of Thander Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-9.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-9.line.0: Keep the road wide and when you're busy, it's easy for people to forget to look down.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-10.title: Herrscher of Thander Mei .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-10.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-10.line.0: Do you usually eat well? It's not normal to eat until it comes back to mind.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-11.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei Daily Interest II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-11.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-11.line.0: If we get a hot meal after a busy day, today is not all tired.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-12.title: Herrscher of Thander Mei Research Opinion One
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-12.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-12.line.0: The failure of the record is not a disgrace, and it may be needed in the next judgement.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-13.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei Research Opinion II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-13.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-13.line.0: The result, which could not be explained for the time being, could be left behind without rushing to return it to success or failure.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-14.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei Select and Target One
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-14.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-14.line.0: If both options give you hesitation, think first of all about what you are the least willing to lose.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-15.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei Select and Goal Two
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-15.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-15.line.0: Others can listen to their expectations, but those who follow that path end up with you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-16.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei Rest Care One
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-16.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-16.line.0: You can take a break. Things don't get meaningless because you sit down for a moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-17.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei Rest Care II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-17.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-17.line.0: If you're tired now, you don't have to try and find me an interesting topic.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-18.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei Quiet for a moment
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-18.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-18.line.0: It's nice to be quiet for a moment, and I don't think every meeting has to say it all the time.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-19.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-19.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-19.line.0: I'm listening, but there's no need to rush. You can say it slowly.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-20.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei... we'll talk about it later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-20.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-20.line.0: Let's get this over with. We can leave what we want to talk to each other.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-21.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-21.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-21.line.0: I hope you have a little more time for yourself today.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-22.title: Herrscher of Thander Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-22.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-22.line.0: Good morning, let's wake ourselves up before we schedule the first thing for today.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-23.title: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-23.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-23.line.0: It's raining. Don't push it for a few steps. Let's find a place to avoid it.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-24.title: Herrscher of Thander Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-24.speaker: Herrscher of Thunder Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V01-24.line.0: It is so late that if there is nothing to do now, leave it to tomorrow.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-1.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-1.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-1.line.0: Hello, another man willing to open the road himself.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-1.line.1: You've been a long way. I'd like to hear your answer to where we're taking this home.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-2.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-2.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-2.line.0: We meet again. This time, do you have any new ideas? It's just a thought.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-3.title: From the source, Herrscher Mei .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-3.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-3.line.0: Moving forward does not mean denying what happened before. Some of the answers are hidden in your experience, which you would like to revisit.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-4.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei. We'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-4.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-4.line.0: There's no need to rush. We'll talk when you take care of what's ahead.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-5.title: From the start, Herrscher Mei...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-5.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-5.line.0: May your next choice remain out of your will. I'll see you next time.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-6.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-6.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-6.line.0: You don't have to be the same as last time you saw each other again, and it's good to have new ideas.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-7.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-7.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-7.line.0: What do you want to start with today? I'd like to hear your judgment first.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-8.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-8.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-8.line.0: Home is not just a place to go, it's where you decide to leave again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-9.title: From the start, Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-9.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-9.line.0: If there were a few things here that had nothing to do with efficiency, it might be more like your life.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-10.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-10.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-10.line.0: Sometimes I think that the most unforgettable, not necessarily the biggest moment of a journey.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-11.title: From here, Herrscher Mei. Daily interest two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-11.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-11.line.0: Did you say that after a long walk, it became clear what it meant?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-12.title: From here, Herrscher Mei .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-12.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-12.line.0: The results that can be replicated are trustworthy, but the courage to try to get out for the first time should not be forgotten.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-13.title: From Herrscher Mei Research Opinion II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-13.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-13.line.0: Recognition of the need to change the old approach when it is no longer appropriate is also a step forward.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-14.title: From here, Herrscher Mei. Select with target one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-14.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-14.line.0: You are not asked to be helped by anyone in your own path.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-15.title: Source: Herrscher Mei. Select and Target Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-15.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-15.line.0: A willingness to take the choice does not mean that you have to refuse all stretches to your hand.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-16.title: From here, Herrscher Mei. Rest and care one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-16.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-16.line.0: Rest does not have to be seen as a betrayal of the goal, and long distances need to go on.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-17.title: From Herrscher Mei Rest Care II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-17.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-17.line.0: It would not have been a waste of time if we had just sorted out our minds today.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-18.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei... Quiet for a moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-18.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-18.line.0: We can leave this thought undecided for a while.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-19.title: From Herrscher Mei . Continuous Interactive Reminder
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-19.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-19.line.0: I'm not leaving, and you don't have to be sure that I want to listen.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-20.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei. We'll talk about it later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-20.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-20.line.0: Let's get to work, let's drop the subject for a while. It doesn't mean it's gone forever.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-21.title: From the beginning, Herrscher Mei...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-21.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-21.line.0: May the next time you meet, you still recognize the direction you want.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-22.title: From the very beginning, Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-22.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-22.line.0: A new day begins. This time, what choice do you want to make for yourself?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-23.title: It started with Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-23.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-23.line.0: The rain will change the scenery, but you don't have to decide where you're going.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-24.title: From here, Herrscher Mei.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-24.speaker: From Herrscher Mei
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V02-24.line.0: It's a good night to remember, but don't let anything that hasn't happened get on you tonight.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-1.title: Herrscher of the Void Kiana
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-1.speaker: Herrscher of the Void Kiana
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-1.line.0: Well, this is where you put yourself? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-1.line.1: That's pretty good. Since you've seen me, don't just stand there. Tell me what you want to talk about. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-2.title: Herescher of the Void Kiana again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-2.speaker: Herrscher of the Void Kiana
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-2.line.0: You again. It is best to say something new that I am not interested in hearing the same greeting a million times. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-3.title: Herrscher of the Void Kiana
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-3.speaker: Herrscher of the Void Kiana
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-3.line.0: It's different to have power and know how to use it. Which one are you going to have these devices prove for you? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-4.title: Herrscher of the Void Kiana... we'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-4.speaker: Herrscher of the Void Kiana
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-4.line.0: Let's take care of your business. When you figure out what to say, come back to me. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V03-5.title: Herrscher of the Void Kiana...
