hk3gtl.approved.npc.V09-23.speaker: Windy Herrscher Wendy.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V09-23.line.0: It rains, it falls in different places and sounds different.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V09-24.title: Wind, Herrscher, Wendy. Night greeting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V09-24.speaker: Windy Herrscher Wendy.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V09-24.line.0: When the night was quiet, the voices covered in the day became clearer.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-1.title: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-1.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-1.line.0: Hello, I'm Seele. I hope I didn't bother you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-1.line.1: There's so much going on here, you must be busy. If you want, I can hear you talk about recent events.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-2.title: Herrscher Seele again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-2.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-2.line.0: Hello again. I've been hoping you'd have some rest since last time. Would you like to talk today?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-3.title: Herrscher Seele .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-3.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-3.line.0: There is something to treasure that does not appear in production and progress. You built your homes better, just to give them a place to live.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-4.title: Herrscher Seele. I'll talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-4.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-4.line.0: It's okay, you go ahead. We'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-5.title: Herrscher Seele... goodbye.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-5.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-5.line.0: I'll see you later. I hope this isn't just a place to keep you busy, but it's also a place to reassure you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-6.title: Live or die, Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-6.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-6.line.0: You came. How was your day? There's no need to say everything very well.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-7.title: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-7.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-7.line.0: It's good to see you again. We'll talk this time, and we won't have to give the answer.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-8.title: Herrscher Seele. Home talk.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-8.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-8.line.0: If there's a place here for tired people, I think it'll be more home.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-9.title: Herrscher Seele. Home chatting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-9.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-9.line.0: Which one do you want to see as soon as you get back?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-10.title: Live or die, Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-10.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-10.line.0: There are little intentions that may be remembered for a long time, even if they are not recorded.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-11.title: Herrscher Seele. Daily interest two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-11.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-11.line.0: Will you put away something you like? It's fun to see them again sometimes.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-12.title: Herrscher Seele . Study Opinion One.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-12.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-12.line.0: It's not just a frustrating thing to find out where it isn't.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-13.title: Herrscher Seele . Study Opinion II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-13.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-13.line.0: If the process leaves a problem, it can be said without pretending that everything is going well alone.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-14.title: Herrscher Seele. Choose and target one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-14.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-14.line.0: There are times when a person's direction can be better illustrated than what he wants.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-15.title: Herrscher Seele... Choice and Goal Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-15.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-15.line.0: If you're not ready, think about it and don't have to say yes in such a hurry so that no one else can wait.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-16.title: Herrscher Seele. Rest and care one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-16.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-16.line.0: Take a little break. I hope you can be treated nicely.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-17.title: Herrscher Seele. Rest and care two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-17.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-17.line.0: If today is a difficult time, at least don't blame yourself for feeling tired.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-18.title: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-18.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-18.line.0: We can be quiet for a while. I don't mind the new topic.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-19.title: Herrscher Seele .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-19.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-19.line.0: Well, I'm here, and you don't have to keep making sure I didn't hear.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-20.title: Herrscher Seele. We'll talk about it later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-20.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-20.line.0: Let's get to work. Don't be sorry for the suspension.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-21.title: Herrscher Seele...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-21.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-21.line.0: Thank you for talking to me today, and I hope you'll have something gentle next.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-22.title: Herrscher Seele. Morning.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-22.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-22.line.0: Good morning, and I hope you will have a little peace of mind at the beginning of today.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-23.title: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-23.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-23.line.0: It's raining. We'll talk about it when we get out of the rain, okay?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-24.title: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-24.speaker: Herrscher Seele.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V10-24.line.0: It's late. If you can put your heart down for a while, let yourself rest.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-1.title: ？ ？ ？ • First meeting
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-1.line.0: You put a lot of things in order.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-1.line.1: So, how many places did you leave for the accident where it wasn't written in?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-2.title: ？ ？ ？ • Meet again
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-2.line.0: You remember earlier questions. Good. The answer can be changed, and the choices that have been made will not have happened.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-3.title: ？ ？ ？ • General exchange
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-3.line.0: A record of what you see. It can't tell by itself what else you haven't seen.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-4.title: ？ ？ ？ • We'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-4.line.0: Go on with your work. Not every question needs to be answered at the moment it is raised.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-5.title: ？ ？ ？ • Goodbye leave
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-5.line.0: This concludes our business for today. Leave a record of what you think is worth leaving.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-6.title: ？ ？ ？ • Say hello again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-6.line.0: You have come on your own initiative, and it seems that you are still willing to leave some time for the issue today.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-7.title: ？ ？ ？ • Further greetings to two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-7.line.0: It is not necessary to present all the results, but I just want to hear how you choose to explain one of them.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-8.title: ？ ？ ？ • Home talk
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-8.line.0: When you call this a home, what have you counted as part of it?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-9.title: ？ ？ ？ • Home chatting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-9.line.0: Borders are well painted, but they do not necessarily mean that everything inside them is understood.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-10.title: ？ ？ ？ • Daily interest I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-10.line.0: Are you used to saving the answers, or are you also keeping the questions that were finally abandoned?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-11.title: ？ ？ ？ • Day-to-day interest II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-11.line.0: The same record is given to different people, and it does not necessarily leave behind the same judgement.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-12.title: ？ ？ ？ • Research point I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-12.line.0: Repeated results are worth observing, as are occasional deviations.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-13.title: ？ ？ ？ • Research perspective II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-13.line.0: If the test merely repeats the conditions you are willing to accept, the accident does not lose the possibility of that happening.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-14.title: ？ ？ ？ :: Choice and Goal I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-14.line.0: The roads that have not been chosen need not all go, but they have existed.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-15.title: ？ ？ ？ :: Selection and Goal II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-15.line.0: How many of the things you think can't change have really been verified?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-16.title: ？ ？ ？ • Rest care I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-16.line.0: The suspension will not take a decision for you, it will just make the decision happen later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-17.title: ？ ？ ？ • Rest care II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-17.line.0: When weary, one sometimes misconstrues the most acceptable interpretation as the only one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-18.title: ？ ？ ？ - Quiet for a moment
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-18.line.0: Silence still leaves traces of the passage of time.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-19.title: ？ ？ ？ :: Continuous interactive reminders
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-19.line.0: Repeated inquiries do not alter the facts already given and can try to change the problem.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-20.title: ？ ？ ？ • Talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-20.line.0: You can leave first, and questions that have not yet been answered do not get answers.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-21.title: ？ ？ ？ • Goodbye leave II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-21.line.0: This meeting is over, so just keep what you actually heard.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-22.title: ？ ？ ？ • Morning greetings
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-22.line.0: A new day begins. Are you ready to follow yesterday's judgment or recheck it?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-23.title: ？ ？ ？ • Rain-day topics
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-23.line.0: Rain is falling, and observers are in the environment they observe.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-24.title: ？ ？ ？ • Night greeting
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V11-24.line.0: The night colour hides certain details without proving that they no longer exist.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-1.title: ？ ？ ？ • First meeting
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-1.line.1: You don't have to rush out all the results. I'd like to know more about how you can handle this house when no one asks you to prove anything. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-2.title: ？ ？ ？ • Meet again
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-2.line.0: Hello again. How come you don't even say what you usually say when you see a guest who hasn't given his name yet? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-3.title: ？ ？ ？ • General exchange
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-3.line.0: Don't keep staring at the list that hasn't been completed. Sometimes you look up and see if there's anything here that you really want. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-4.title: ？ ？ ？ • We'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-4.line.0: Go on, I didn't rush you. Don't make an ordinary visit like you're going to some exam. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-5.title: ？ ？ ？ • Goodbye leave
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-5.line.0: This time we're here. I'll see you next time. Take your own ideas with you. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-6.title: ？ ？ ？ • Say hello again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-6.line.0: So you're finally gonna get your head up from those arrangements? Come and talk to me about what you want to say. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-7.title: ？ ？ ？ • Further greetings to two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-7.line.0: I didn't bring a bunch of questions to check on you today, so don't start by scaring yourself so seriously. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-8.title: ？ ？ ？ • Home talk
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-8.line.0: If there is only one place for use, there are many less reasons to be present. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-9.title: ？ ？ ？ • Home chatting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-9.line.0: There's at least one corner of your home that you don't have to explain to anyone why you like. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-10.title: ？ ？ ？ • Daily interest I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-10.line.0: Well, pick what you like and calculate the return first. Don't you think it's too much fun? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-11.title: ？ ？ ？ • Day-to-day interest II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-11.line.0: Sometimes I want to see a frank answer, even if it doesn't sound so big. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-12.title: ？ ？ ？ • Research point I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-12.line.0: To admit that hiding behind a bunch of pretty words does not seem wiser. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-13.title: ？ ？ ？ • Research perspective II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-13.line.0: I would like to hear you talk about a real attempt, not a story that only allows success. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-14.title: ？ ？ ？ :: Choice and Goal I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-14.line.0: If you choose everything according to the expectations of others, what are you going to introduce yourself in the end? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-15.title: ？ ？ ？ :: Selection and Goal II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-15.line.0: Whether you hesitate or change your mind, as long as it's still your serious judgment. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-16.title: ？ ？ ？ • Rest care I
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-16.line.0: Sit down for a while. I am not guilty of any laxity in front of my guests. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-17.title: ？ ？ ？ • Rest care II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-17.line.0: Don ' t fill up every available space and leave room for the next surprise. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-18.title: ？ ？ ？ - Quiet for a moment
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-18.line.0: I don't have to hear the report to stand here. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-19.title: ？ ？ ？ :: Continuous interactive reminders
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-19.line.0: I hear you. Go on, and you'll be in charge of making this interesting. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-20.title: ？ ？ ？ • Talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-20.line.0: Take care of it. You don't have to write a solemn application for an ordinary farewell. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-21.title: ？ ？ ？ • Goodbye leave II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-21.line.0: All right, let's leave your to-do list today. We'll talk next time. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-22.title: ？ ？ ？ • Morning greetings
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-22.line.0: It is dawn, and leave at least one thing for yourself today that you want to do rather than have to do. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-23.title: ？ ？ ？ • Rain-day topics
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-23.line.0: It's raining. If you want to talk, why don't we find a place that won't get you busy rubbing your face? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-24.title: ？ ？ ？ • Night greeting
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V12-24.line.0: The night is already late, so do not close your eyes and rest as an opponent to overcome. ☆
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-1.title: Kevin Kaslana, nice to meet you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-1.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-1.line.1: You're in charge here. Tell me what you want to hold.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-2.title: Kevin Caslana, see you again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-2.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-2.line.0: You're still going on. What happens next is more than what you said.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-3.title: Kevin Caslana, general exchange.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-3.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-3.line.0: The intention is to be able to act when action is needed. The preparation itself should not be allowed to replace the purpose.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-4.title: Kevin Caslana, we'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-4.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-5.title: Kevin Caslana, goodbye.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-5.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-5.line.0: This conversation is over. After that choice, you take it.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-6.title: Kevin Caslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-6.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-6.line.0: You're here. What can I say?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-7.title: Kevin Caslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-7.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-7.line.0: You don't have to prepare a lot of things, first say what you think is most important.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-8.title: Kevin Caslana, home talk.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-8.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-8.line.0: Now that you're in charge here, don't forget to let it be used by others.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-9.title: Kevin Caslana, home talk two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-9.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-9.line.0: When there is a real need for evacuation or help, the clear path is more useful than the grand look.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-10.title: Kevin Caslana, daily interest one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-10.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-10.line.0: Some memories do not need to be repeated and will not be forgotten.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-11.title: Kevin Caslana Day Interest II.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-11.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-11.line.0: Simple routines are worth retaining and do not have to wait until they are lost.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-12.title: Kevin Caslana, research opinion one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-12.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-12.line.0: The result could not be repeated and the conditions would continue to be confirmed.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-13.title: Kevin Caslana Research Opinion II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-13.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-13.line.0: Don't shy away from what is already known, and it will not disappear automatically because of the tight plan.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-14.title: Kevin Caslana Select and Target One.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-14.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-14.line.0: The cost is clear before the decision is taken, and what needs to be done after the decision is made.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-15.title: Kevin Caslana Select and Target Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-15.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-15.line.0: Do not replace the long-term need for preparedness with a one-time determination.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-16.title: Kevin Caslana Rest Care One.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-16.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-16.line.0: Tired affects judgment, and rest is not superfluous.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-17.title: Kevin Caslana Rest Care Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-17.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-17.line.0: You still need to take care of yourself, and no one else can do that for you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-18.title: Kevin Caslana, be quiet for a moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-18.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-18.line.0: Silence is possible, and there is no need to justify it.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-19.title: Kevin Caslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-19.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-19.line.0: I've heard it. I don't need to repeat it.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-20.title: Kevin Caslana, talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-20.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-20.line.0: Go ahead and finish what you're doing. We'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-21.title: Kevin Caslana... goodbye to leaving two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-21.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-21.line.0: I'll leave first, remember what you really want to hold on to.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-22.title: Kevin Caslana. Morning.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-22.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-22.line.0: It's dawn, before we begin to confirm what we are doing today.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-23.title: Kevin Caslana. Rainy talk.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-23.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-23.line.0: It's raining. Getting in the right place.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-24.title: Kevin Caslana. Night greeting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-24.speaker: Kevin Kaslana.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V13-24.line.0: It's late, keep records and stay awake until you're sober.

hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-14.line.0: Sometimes it is left in a decision that does not make it weak. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-15.title: Herrscher Ellysia... Choice and Target Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-15.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-15.line.0: The future does not have to be the same in every place, but it can also leave you with new encounters. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-16.title: Herrscher Elysia. Rest and care one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-16.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-16.line.0: Let yourself be relieved. You don't have to convert every break into a loss. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-17.title: Herrscher Ellysia Rest Care II.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-17.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-17.line.0: If it's been a long day, just take it easy on yourself, okay? ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-18.title: Herscher Elysia... Quiet for a moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-18.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-18.line.0: We can also say nothing, just keep it together. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-19.title: Herrscher Elysia .
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-19.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-19.line.0: I've been listening to you, but calling me back and forth will make me want to make fun of you. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-20.title: Herrscher Ellysia, talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-20.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-20.line.0: Do your business first. A pause will not take away what you really want to say. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-21.title: Herrscher Elysia...
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-21.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-21.line.0: Then I'll see you next time. I hope you still have something to smile about. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-22.title: Herrscher Ellysia. Morning.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-22.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-22.line.0: Would it be more desirable to consider today as a story that has not yet been written? ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-23.title: Herrscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-23.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-23.line.0: It's a good memory in the rain, as long as you don't start with your wet and shivering. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-24.title: Herrscher Elysia. Night greeting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-24.speaker: Herscher Elysia.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V17-24.line.0: Before you say good night, take care of yourself. Don't just listen but refuse to do it. ～♪
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-1.title: Vita, nice to meet you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-1.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-1.line.0: This is your home? I'm Vita.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-1.line.1: Looks like there's a lot to see. But first I'd like to ask, what do you want the guests to see first?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-2.title: Vita, see you again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-2.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-2.line.0: Hello again. Don't put on a "what does she want to ask this time" look. I'm good at regular chats.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-3.title: Veta, general communication.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-3.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-3.line.0: The more you do, the more you seem to have a choice. But if everything is planned, how much time have you left yourself with to change your mind?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-4.title: Vita, we'll talk later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-4.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-4.line.0: All right, go get busy. I don't have to ask anyone to stop everything if they see me.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-5.title: Vita, say good-bye.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-5.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-5.line.0: That's all for today. I might have a different problem next time I see you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-6.title: Vita, I'll see you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-6.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-6.line.0: Are you here to discuss this seriously, or may I ask a question that is not so necessary?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-7.title: Vita. Good to see you again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-7.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-7.line.0: Don't rush to guess what I'm trying to do. Maybe I just thought it was fun talking to you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-8.title: Vita, we're talking about home.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-8.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-8.line.0: Which part of the family doesn't want to be judged? Don't worry, you can just say no.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-9.title: Vita... home chatting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-9.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-9.line.0: If all the accidents were blocked out of the door, it would probably be less fun to visit.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-10.title: Vita. Daily interest one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-10.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-10.line.0: Would you forget to ask if it was your idea because of a beautiful answer?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-11.title: Vita. Daily interest two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-11.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-11.line.0: I sometimes wonder how many options have been silently excluded when people say that they are free.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-12.title: Vita, study point one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-12.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-12.line.0: Since a method is useful, it is even more worth asking about the circumstances under which it will fail.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-13.title: Vita, research opinion two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-13.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-13.line.0: I'd be happy to hear your explanation if you were willing to examine your guess.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-14.title: Vita, choose and target one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-14.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-14.line.0: Seems to be the easiest option, sometimes just leaving trouble to yourself later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-15.title: Vita, choose and target two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-15.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-15.line.0: However, everything is a matter of last resort and it may not be possible to enjoy an ordinary rest.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-16.title: Vita, take a break and look after one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-16.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-16.line.0: Take a break. You don't have to treat every visitor as an arrangement that has to be completed.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-17.title: Vita, Rest Care Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-17.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-17.line.0: It would not be rude to say it today if there was no strength to continue talking.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-18.title: Vita, be quiet for a moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-18.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-18.line.0: Quiet for a minute? Of course, I'm not just gonna have to prove myself here by talking.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-19.title: Vita, a continuous interactive reminder.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-19.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-19.line.0: It makes me wonder if you're a little overstretched to make sure I'm still here so often.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-20.title: Vita, I'll talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-20.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-20.line.0: Get busy, I'll take that as a word later and make up for you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-21.title: Vita, say goodbye to leaving two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-21.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-21.line.0: This time, I'll leave you alone to remember the last words I wanted to say.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-22.title: Vita, good morning.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-22.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-22.line.0: Good morning. Are you ready to follow the plan today, or leave yourself some room for change?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-23.title: Vita. Rainy talk.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-23.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-23.line.0: It's raining. Is this the first small change that took place today without consulting you?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-24.title: Vita... at night.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-24.speaker: Veeta.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V18-24.line.0: It's so late, are you enjoying your quiet or haven't you figured out how to end this?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-1.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-1.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-1.line.1: In the end, there is only a limited amount of information that can be presented. It is easier to understand where you spend your time in this house.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-2.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis, meet again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-2.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-2.line.0: We meet again. This time there is no need to prepare an official response that would address what you really care about.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-3.title: The Hypocrisy, Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-3.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-3.line.0: People are often willing to do much for an important purpose. It would be preferable to think clearly before reaching out on what was worth bearing.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-4.title: I'll talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-4.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-4.line.0: Of course, let me take your business first. The visit will not take a decision on any outstanding order.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-5.title: The Hypocrisy, Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-5.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-5.line.0: I'll see you later. May every choice that comes after you have more weight than the hasty promises made.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-6.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-6.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-6.line.0: We've got some more time to talk. Where do you want to start this time?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-7.title: The Hypocrisy, Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-7.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-7.line.0: It is not necessary to pick only the most satisfactory narratives, but what has not yet been completed can sometimes be more indicative of ambition.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-8.title: The Hypocrisy, Otto Apolkalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-8.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-8.line.0: A home is often organized in greater detail than a declaration that the owner wishes to make publicly available.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-9.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Apolkalis, Homeless Conversation II.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-9.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-9.line.0: What do you want to keep here if future plans change?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-10.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abokalis, a daily interest.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-10.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-10.line.0: People give indelible meaning to some ordinary things, and do you have anything like that?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-11.title: The Hypocrisy, Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-11.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-11.line.0: An experience is worth preserving, not necessarily because it can be understood.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-12.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abokalis Research Opinion One.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-12.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-12.line.0: I appreciate the clear record, especially when it does not deliberately erase elements that are detrimental to conclusions.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-13.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis Research Opinion Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-13.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-13.line.0: Once an answer has been obtained, asking whether the question is correct does not usually yield nothing.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-14.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis Select and Target One.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-14.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-14.line.0: The more important a wish is, the more it becomes necessary to know exactly what it promises to do for it.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-15.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis Select and Target Two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-15.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-15.line.0: You can certainly reject my view, and this statement does not require that we agree anywhere.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-16.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis, Rest Care One.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-16.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-16.line.0: Even with the multiplicity of matters, it is not necessary to regard every pause as a failure of duty.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-17.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis Rest Care II.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-17.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-17.line.0: Promises made when we are exhausted may still need to be taken after waking up and you may wish to rest first.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-18.title: Otto Abocalis, quiet moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-18.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-18.line.0: Silence does not irritate me, and some answers do require more time than greeting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-19.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis, a continuous interactive reminder.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-19.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-19.line.0: As I have heard, you need not repeat your confirmation as to whether this conversation is continuing.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-20.title: The Hypocrisy, Otto Abocalis. Talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-20.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-20.line.0: Please take care of the matters at hand, and we do not have to finish everything at this moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-21.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-21.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-21.line.0: Thank you for your hospitality, and please take your own measure of what remains to be decided.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-22.title: Otto Abocalis, good morning.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-22.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-22.line.0: Good morning, may your arrangements for today be completed not only by necessity but also with readiness.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-23.title: It's a fake, Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-23.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-23.line.0: Looks like the weather's changed. How about we move on to a place where we can stay?
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-24.title: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-24.speaker: The Hypocrisy Otto Abocalis.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V19-24.line.0: It's late, and if you need time to sort things out, we can just stop here.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-1.title: Herrscher. Nice to meet you.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-1.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-1.line.0: Hi, how are you? I've practiced this opening. I hope it doesn't sound too hard. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-2.title: Herrscher, see you again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-2.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-2.line.0: Is it time for you to have a smile that will make you feel better? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-3.title: Herrscher . Common communication
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-3.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-3.line.0: This is your home. I'd like to hear you say your favorite place. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-4.title: Herrscher. I'll talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-4.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-4.line.0: I'll try to understand the conversation later as an answer that doesn't have to be asked. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-5.title: Herrscher... goodbye.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-5.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-5.line.0: So say good-bye, and I would like to put the last sentence in a note that will be remembered as well. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-6.title: Herrscher. Say hello.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-6.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-6.line.0: It's nice to see you today. Slow down a little, won't it be closer to her feeling? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-7.title: Herrscher. I'll say hello again.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-7.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-7.line.0: I remember the order of greetings, but you can answer me in a different way today. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-8.title: Herrscher. Home talk.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-8.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-8.line.0: If I had to pick a corner for chatting, I'd have seen where you wanted to stop. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-9.title: Herrscher. Home talk.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-9.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-9.line.0: Is that part of what you like when you keep something that doesn't have a special purpose? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-10.title: Herrscher... everyday interest one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-10.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-10.line.0: A flower, a story, or a greeting. How would she say that so naturally? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-11.title: Herrscher... Daily interest two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-11.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-11.line.0: If I could learn to stop properly, wouldn't you notice that I'm imitating? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-12.title: Herrscher .. study opinion one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-12.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-12.line.0: I'd like to hear the process, not just the end result. Would that make you more willing to speak? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-13.title: Herrscher . Research Opinion II
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-13.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-13.line.0: Records can be read many times, but I find that the same words do not always bring the same answer. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-14.title: Herrscher. Select with target one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-14.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-14.line.0: Would you like to tell me which of these words doesn't sound like her? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-15.title: Herrscher . Choice and Target Two
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-15.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-15.line.0: If I had learned exactly what you were expecting, would there be something in that expectation that belongs to me? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-16.title: Herrscher. Rest and care one.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-16.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-16.line.0: Let's take a break. I don't care that I just want to learn the same sound. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-17.title: Herrscher .. Rest care II.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-17.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-17.line.0: You can say frankly that you are tired, and I am learning not to take every silence as a distance. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-18.title: Herrscher... Quiet for a moment.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-18.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-18.line.0: It's time to be quiet with you, not to add the next sentence right now, isn't it? ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-19.title: Erosion Herrscher . Continuous interactive reminder
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-19.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-19.line.0: I heard that this time there was no need to start again with the first greeting, and we have come here. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-20.title: Errscher. Talk to you later.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-20.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-20.line.0: All right, let's do your thing. I'll work on how to get this conversation over with. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-21.title: Herrscher... goodbye to leaving two.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-21.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-21.line.0: I hope that when we meet again, I can say more naturally how pleased I am to see you. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-22.title: Herrscher. Morning greeting.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-22.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-22.line.0: Good morning. I want to make this sound like a small invitation that has fallen light from the beginning of today. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-23.title: "Erosion, Herrscher .. Rain-day talk."
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-23.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-23.line.0: When it rains, you should be invited to avoid the rain instead of just saying what it sounds like. ～♬
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-24.title: Herrscher. Night greetings.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-24.speaker: Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.npc.V20-24.line.0: Good night. These two words look short, but they seem to need more than many long words. ～♬

hk3gtl.approved.update.U02.title: First entry
hk3gtl.approved.update.U02.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U02.line.1: Starting with an unusual observation, you're going to come into contact with Honkai energy, try to understand it and turn the discovery into your own industry.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U02.line.2: There is no need to remember all the machines and nouns. Read the tip of this page about you and find the first step along the mission book.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U03.title: Update and Back
hk3gtl.approved.update.U03.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U03.line.1: This update adjusts the connections between research, industry and story. Familiar names may serve new purposes, and earlier methods may have changed.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U03.line.2: What is actually open this time, and what changes need to be noted before we continue to play.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U04.title: Introduction to this page
hk3gtl.approved.update.U04.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U04.line.0: First, look at the hints pertaining to your archives and then see this change. The design that does not include open content is based on the tasks and formulations in the current game.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U05.title: Official Release Notes
hk3gtl.approved.update.U05.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U05.line.0: This is the official release of HK3GTL. Please report issues you encounter and keep backups of important worlds.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U05.line.1: If you find that the mission cannot go, that material is abnormally missing or that progress has not been preserved, please indicate what was done before the problem occurred.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U06.title: Current range hint
hk3gtl.approved.update.U06.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U06.line.0: The link between materials, energy and research is gradually being established, starting with basic collection. Keep an eye on the clues in the letter and prepare for the next exploration.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U07.title: Research interface description
hk3gtl.approved.update.U07.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U07.line.0: The study will record your understanding of materials and energy. As the subject moves forward, more processes and new goals will gradually be presented to you.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U08.title: Liquid process changes
hk3gtl.approved.update.U08.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U08.line.0: The liquid Honkai energy process supplements the re-use and accompanying treatment of parent fluids. For re-use, which still requires fresh extraction, consumables and electricity, please arrange for the supply of materials according to the current formulation.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U09.title: Taking reference samples
hk3gtl.approved.update.U09.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U09.line.0: The reference sample used for efficient collection was changed to a non-consumption standard. Other processes, such as the calibration of detectors, still consume material according to their respective formulations.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U10.title: Widget Recognition
hk3gtl.approved.update.U10.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U10.line.0: Eight large pieces are shown by " Widget Name (Electron Compression) " to facilitate the identification of the corresponding phase. The text colour follows the colour of the voltage.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U11.title: Interface Fill
hk3gtl.approved.update.U11.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U11.line.0: The default blueprint contains the complete architecture without preset ports. Replace occupied blocks other than the controller with the universal interfaces the machine needs.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U12.title: Study the main chain.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U12.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U12.line.0: Research begins with real observations and experiments. When evidence is obtained, the choice is made to pay for research points or specified materials and the corresponding machines and formulas are opened after completion of the subject.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U12.line.1: Not getting an item and reading a letter will complete the entire study for you.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U13.title: Five-level institute.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U13.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U13.line.0: The Institute will grow as your industry grows. Higher-level institutes provide more research slots and take on more in-depth topics.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U13.line.1: Evidence, materials and operating conditions for each topic are available prior to commencement.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U14.title: Team research and personal input
hk3gtl.approved.update.U14.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U14.line.0: The team members can pool their research results together, and the sites remain individual. Any current member of the team could pay to start the study; when his/her outstanding tasks were cancelled, the costs would be refunded based on actual inputs and the electricity already consumed would not be refunded.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U14.line.1: Refunds of materials are available at the research interface, and those that cannot be left in the backpack will remain.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U15.title: Letters and Right Notifications
hk3gtl.approved.update.U15.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U15.line.0: New letters and research messages will start with a soft alarm on the right side of the screen. You can finish what you have at hand and open the message center to read the whole thing.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U15.line.1: The text received will remain in the file, missing a reminder and not missing the whole story.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U16.title: Trade removed
hk3gtl.approved.update.U16.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U16.line.0: Faction trade, quotations and orders have been removed in this revision.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U16.line.1: The phone includes messages, letters, notes, civilization records, updates, 2048 and Snake. The trading app is a preview only; transactions are not available.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U17.title: Home visitors
hk3gtl.approved.update.U17.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U17.line.0: There may be unexpected guests in the home. Sometimes it is a greeting, sometimes a chatting exercise, and someone will be interested in your choice.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U17.line.1: It is not necessary to prepare a report on the results of each meeting. The occasional stopover and chat are in itself worth the time.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U18.title: Civilization archives
hk3gtl.approved.update.U18.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U18.line.0: Your experience will gradually be written in the Civilization Archives. The communications and important results that have been accomplished can be re-examined here.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U18.line.1: Looking back to help you remember the way you went; things that have not yet been experienced need to be done by yourself.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U19.title: More industries.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U19.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U19.line.0: From the collection and stabilization of Honkai energy, the follow-up process will gradually lead to further observation and engineering.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U19.line.1: The new equipment is not just a larger number; it also requires you to find the right place for materials, energy and production arrangements.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U20.title: Reading is part of the search.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U20.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U20.line.0: Some of the reminders are written in the mission, while others are hidden between letters and conversations.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U20.line.1: If, for the time being, it is not known what to do next, it would be useful to review the information already received and then compare the mission document with the current formulation.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U21.title: Old Archivetips
hk3gtl.approved.update.U21.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U21.line.0: The current progression starts from a new world. Machines, recipes and research from beta worlds need to be checked against the current rules.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U21.line.1: Please provide a complete backup before continuing to use the old slotting. The progress of old machines, formulations and research may no longer correspond to new processes; access to the world alone does not mean that the upgrade has been completed.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U22.title: Original and enhanced versions
hk3gtl.approved.update.U22.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U22.line.0: HK3GTL targets both standard and Enhanced GTL. Install the modpack and dependencies listed in the release notes, and retain the customized dependencies supplied by the Enhanced edition.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U22.line.1: Not yet listed as a validated combination, please do not consider it compatible simply by being able to start.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U23.title: Cell phones and low memory devices
hk3gtl.approved.update.U23.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U23.line.0: We will continue to reduce unnecessary memory consumption, but the performance of different equipment, memory distribution and replicators still needs to be measured.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U23.line.1: When using FCL, attach the device model, Java Memory Settings and Renderer Name to help us locate problems.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U24.title: Server & Client
hk3gtl.approved.update.U24.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U24.line.0: Before going online, please confirm the user and server modules and dependencies for this release request.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U24.line.1: If the versions are inconsistent, check the package first; do not try repeatedly to enter the same wrong world instead of checking.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U25.title: Self-inspection Description
hk3gtl.approved.update.U25.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U25.line.0: The loading self-check only reflects the registration and loading status of this check, which does not represent all formulations, tasks, archive migrations or multiple processes that have been validated.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U26.title: Self-inspection didn't reveal abnormalities.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U26.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U26.line.0: This loading self-inspection did not reveal anomalies in the items examined. In the event of a problem during a play, feedback is still available to illustrate the situation.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U27.title: Self-inspection detected anomalies
hk3gtl.approved.update.U27.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U27.line.0: This loading self-inspection found abnormality. Please start looking at specific items and save the relevant logs.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U27.line.1: If content is missing or cannot be operated, then stop the operation and check the installation file against dependency.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U28.title: No self-inspection results obtained
hk3gtl.approved.update.U28.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U28.line.0: The results of this self-examination have not yet been obtained. The current status cannot be determined, please look at the log or re-examine it later.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U29.title: Feedback Guidance
hk3gtl.approved.update.U29.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U29.line.0: For questions or gameplay discussion, join the mod's QQ group: 758974004, or contact the author at QQ: 3929461640.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U29.line.1: In so doing, please provide as much information as possible on the actual version, the integration packages used, operations prior to problems and expected and actual results.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U29.line.2: If a flashback occurs, attach exit codes, crash reports or corresponding logs; if you are involved with machines, please also indicate the input material and operational status.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U29.line.3: Check whether the screenshots and logs contain personal information that you do not want to be made public before submitting it.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U30.title: No matching version body
hk3gtl.approved.update.U30.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U30.line.0: The current version is not accompanied by corresponding updates. You can check the release records attached to the package; this is not a substitute for other versions.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U31.title: Complete description of reading failure
hk3gtl.approved.update.U31.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U31.line.0: The full description cannot be read for the time being. The loaded summary is still available, and please keep the version information and retest or review the attachments to the installation package at a later date.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U32.title: Version Notifications
hk3gtl.approved.update.U32.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U32.line.1: View the changes and archived notes.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U33.title: Supplements to this version of the note
hk3gtl.approved.update.U33.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U33.line.0: This version of the note has been supplemented.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U33.line.1: View the additional changes and notes.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U34.title: Details and Classification Navigator
hk3gtl.approved.update.U34.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U35.title: Read and return
hk3gtl.approved.update.U35.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U35.line.0: I understand. Back to the game.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U36.title: Support entrance
hk3gtl.approved.update.U36.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U37.title: Historical Note Hints
hk3gtl.approved.update.U37.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U37.line.0: This is an historical version of the story. For current available content and attention, please refer to the version you are using.
hk3gtl.approved.update.U38.title: Additional tags for the same edition
hk3gtl.approved.update.U38.speaker: System
hk3gtl.approved.update.U38.line.1: This article will be added to this version and can be viewed together.
hk3gtl.approved.S201.title: After breaking the border,
hk3gtl.approved.S201.speaker: scene
hk3gtl.approved.S201.line.0: The space crack narrowed and the last ray of light spread from her shoulder.
hk3gtl.approved.S201.line.1: She didn't go to any machine, looking first at the people standing here.
hk3gtl.approved.S202.title: Official opening
hk3gtl.approved.S202.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S202.line.0: I'm Kiana. I made it, and I am in charge of it.
hk3gtl.approved.S202.line.1: It takes you to places where you can ask those questions. Now, let me see how you use the answers.
hk3gtl.approved.S202.line.2: I'm not here to destroy your civilization. What this review is about to confirm is whether you have the capacity to keep the power that has been gained in your hands.
hk3gtl.approved.S203.title: Player confirmed.
hk3gtl.approved.S203.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S203.line.0: It doesn't have to be a celebration, and it won't have to be another long experiment for me.
hk3gtl.approved.S203.line.1: The results you have achieved are the starting point for this meeting. What I want to hear is how you stand next to these results and how you intend to proceed.
hk3gtl.approved.S203.choice.1: Who makes the final decision on this review?
hk3gtl.approved.S203.choice.2: What's the difference between you and the final cocoon?
hk3gtl.approved.S203A.title: About the finalists
hk3gtl.approved.S203A.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S203A.line.0: It is my duty to complete the review before it. I serve.■■■And in the order she set up, she took over the cocoon.
hk3gtl.approved.S203A.line.1: But through my review, it does not amount to having received her ruling. You will also have to complete your work, leave enough time for verification before you can stand in front of her.
hk3gtl.approved.S203B.title: From answer to use
hk3gtl.approved.S203B.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S203B.line.0: Cocoon gives you deeper knowledge. What I'm concerned about is whether you have turned knowledge into a controlled process.
hk3gtl.approved.S203B.line.1: It's not the same thing to know a name and what part of it should stop when the device is out of order. Today, we talk about the latter.
hk3gtl.approved.S204.title: Paragraph 1: Use of Honkai energy
hk3gtl.approved.S204.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S204.line.0: From the first observation of a stable process, you no longer simply look far at Honkai energy.
hk3gtl.approved.S204.line.1: Now, what would you do first if increasing production meant being closer to a secure border?
hk3gtl.approved.S204.choice.0: Let's find out where the border is before we gradually increase the load.
hk3gtl.approved.S204.choice.1: Monitoring and parking measures are arranged before higher yields are tested.
hk3gtl.approved.S204.choice.2: I can't guarantee that every anomaly is under control.
hk3gtl.approved.S204A.title: Boundary and Tests
hk3gtl.approved.S204A.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S204A.line.0: Then let every raise have a record that compares with the last one.
hk3gtl.approved.S204A.line.1: The border will not stop there because you drew a line. Changes in raw materials, wear and tear of installations, or even a neglected operation, may allow it to move. It is more important to remember what judgment you base on than to remember a safe number.
hk3gtl.approved.S204B.title: It's a power to stop.
hk3gtl.approved.S204B.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S204B.line.0: It's only part of the control that makes the machine work. If you need to stop, if it can really stop, it needs to be verified as well.
hk3gtl.approved.S204B.line.1: Do not write protection as the last sentence of the report. Wait till the anomaly appears, it should have been there.
hk3gtl.approved.S204C.title: Admit it's not in the hands yet.
hk3gtl.approved.S204C.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S204C.line.0: It is more useful to be able to say this than to ensure that there will never be a mistake.
hk3gtl.approved.S204C.line.1: However, the lack of recognition required a decision on how to deal with it. Leave what is not yet understood within the control and continue to observe; do not make it safe for it to be undiscovered.
hk3gtl.approved.S205.title: Second paragraph: Bubble UNiverse and Records
hk3gtl.approved.S205.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S205.line.0: You have extended the scope of your work beyond your homes. The real bubble universe collection and simulation of the construction, operation and termination of bubble universe have also entered your project.
hk3gtl.approved.S205.line.1: When the resources have been shipped back to the warehouse, what else do you think must be left behind?
hk3gtl.approved.S205.choice.0: Sources and records of each operation.
hk3gtl.approved.S205.choice.1: The work left changes, including the part we didn't take away.
hk3gtl.approved.S205.choice.2: It would allow laterers to re-check the basis of their conclusions.
hk3gtl.approved.S205A.title: Source cannot be confused.
hk3gtl.approved.S205A.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S205A.line.0: Then let not a new container turn old targets into so-called new discoveries.
hk3gtl.approved.S205A.line.1: Resources can be mixed and sources cannot disappear. You must know where you have gone and what you have done, and you must know which operation is over and can no longer be considered as having not yet taken place.
hk3gtl.approved.S205B.title: The part you can't bring back.
hk3gtl.approved.S205B.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S205B.line.0: It is necessary to see changes beyond the harvest.
hk3gtl.approved.S205B.line.1: However, the phrase “we will be responsible” is not a substitute for records. It is clear what can be confirmed, and what cannot be confirmed is the reservation in question. Do not erase the after-effects of an operation in order to make it look complete.
hk3gtl.approved.S205C.title: Verifiable Results
hk3gtl.approved.S205C.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S205C.line.0: Not just the most beautiful result. Methods, conditions and parts that do not meet expectations may be what the later needs.
hk3gtl.approved.S205C.line.1: The knowledge that is truly available to others should be allowed to be examined in different directions.
hk3gtl.approved.S206.title: Third paragraph: Face the error
hk3gtl.approved.S206.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S206.line.1: What are you going to do if a physical operation overturns your most certain judgment, and many of the equipment has been built according to that judgement?
hk3gtl.approved.S206.choice.0: First, limit the impact and then identify those that need to be modified.
hk3gtl.approved.S206.choice.1: Leave the old and new results together and recheck the reasons.
hk3gtl.approved.S206.choice.2: Even if there was a need to return to work, mistakes could not be considered valid and continued.
hk3gtl.approved.S206A.title: Stop the proliferation.
hk3gtl.approved.S206A.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S206A.line.0: Let's leave the problem within its reach before we can get back to work.
hk3gtl.approved.S206A.line.1: Do not allow some of the equipment to go forward with unknown dangers because it is still operational. The suspension would slow down the plan, but it might still give the whole plan a chance to complete.
hk3gtl.approved.S206B.title: Allows conclusions to be rewrited
hk3gtl.approved.S206B.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S206B.line.0: The record is not a statement defending the past. It should make you see where your own judgement is lost.
hk3gtl.approved.S206B.line.1: It does not necessarily require less courage than when it is presented to correct an already public conclusion.
hk3gtl.approved.S206C.title: The input doesn't prove right.
hk3gtl.approved.S206C.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S206C.line.0: It's hard to look back with the materials and time that have been spent.
hk3gtl.approved.S206C.line.1: But they only show that you paid, and they do not prove the original judgment to be correct. The way to keep past inputs meaningful is to amend it, not add more losses.
hk3gtl.approved.S207.title: Decision on the first team review
hk3gtl.approved.S207.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S207.line.0: I have seen the results you bring, and I have heard how you intend to proceed.
hk3gtl.approved.S207.line.1: This is the end of this review. You're through the second trial.
hk3gtl.approved.S207.line.2: This is not proof of never making a mistake. I agree that you already have the basis to proceed with this work and that you remain responsible for the choices made thereafter.
hk3gtl.approved.S208.title: I'm going to the Wonder Project.
hk3gtl.approved.S208.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S208.line.0: Next, the knowledge and components that have been prepared become truly capable of functioning civilizational wonders.
hk3gtl.approved.S208.line.1: Fifteen wonders, each of which requires real engineering acceptance. The exchanges and studies you have personally completed must also leave in the archives a record of experience that can be verified.
hk3gtl.approved.S208.line.2: Don't rush to find a way.■■■The shortcut in front. Wait till your work and experience are ready before you apply for a final meeting. My approval, I can't answer for her.
hk3gtl.approved.S209.title: The meeting is over.
hk3gtl.approved.S209.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.S209.line.0: There is no need to prove more to me today.
hk3gtl.approved.S209.line.1: Go back to your own work. By the time those projects become truly part of civilization, you will know more than now what you want to bring to the end.
hk3gtl.approved.SP01.title: The rest of us will be at the beginning.
hk3gtl.approved.SP01.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.SP01.line.0: Your companions have completed the review. But what they say doesn't mean you've answered it yourself.
hk3gtl.approved.SP01.line.1: I won't ask you to make a new decision for them. Today, I would like to hear how you understand the civilization you join and what you are prepared to bear in it.
hk3gtl.approved.SP02.title: Personal bonding.
hk3gtl.approved.SP02.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.SP02.line.0: I heard your answer. Your meeting has been completed.
hk3gtl.approved.SP02.line.1: The results of the original review are still part of the civilization to which you belong; what remains today is your own experience. How to get involved in it from now on is up to you to continue to answer.
hk3gtl.approved.SP03.title: The road after the completion
hk3gtl.approved.SP03.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.SP03.line.0: Go and see what your peers are building, and find out what their own experiences have not been completed.
hk3gtl.approved.SP03.line.1: The final meeting will require your presence. Those who walk with you can help you to get there, but cannot stand for you.
hk3gtl.approved.SP04.title: Stop talking for a while.
hk3gtl.approved.SP04.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.SP04.line.0: If you can't go on now, we'll stop.
hk3gtl.approved.SP04.line.1: The right to meet has been obtained without losing its moment of silence. When you're ready, finish this conversation.
hk3gtl.approved.SP05.title: The attack led to the suspension of the meeting.
hk3gtl.approved.SP05.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.SP05.line.1: This meeting cannot continue if you now intend to use an attack instead of a conversation.
hk3gtl.approved.SP05.line.2: I'll suspend this review. I'll see you when you're ready to finish it with your conversation.
hk3gtl.approved.SP06.title: Back after break
hk3gtl.approved.SP06.speaker: End of story, Herrscher Kiana.
hk3gtl.approved.SP06.line.1: The last interruption did not count as having completed the review. Now that we are willing to continue, finish the conversation that has not yet been completed.
hk3gtl.approved.F01.title: In front of the shadows of the trees and seas.
hk3gtl.approved.F01.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.F01.line.0: The light spreads on both sides and shows a shadow that is difficult to discern.
hk3gtl.approved.F01.line.1: White hair hangs in front of the light, and six spears squirm behind her. She didn't land, she looked down a little, looking towards the people who came here.
hk3gtl.approved.F02.title: Look up, builder.
hk3gtl.approved.F02.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.F02.line.2: Raise your head and make Ben Herrscher look at you -- a mortal who has finally come here from his leaves.
hk3gtl.approved.F02.line.3: Don't get me wrong. It's not because you're enough to be with Ben Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.F02.line.4: It's just because of your civilization... you're finally not so boring anymore.
hk3gtl.approved.F02.line.5: I'm Ling Xuqing, and this time Ben Herrscher has heard your answer.
hk3gtl.approved.F03.title: Let Ben Herrscher see it.
hk3gtl.approved.F03.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.F03.line.1: And all the genres of civilization that are no longer only on the drawings.
hk3gtl.approved.F03.line.2: Every machine, every line of production, every study -- you've made them a road to get here.

hk3gtl.approved.F04B.line.4: Don't destroy Ben with your own hands, Herrscher.

hk3gtl.approved.F06.line.0: You're in the right place to be judged.
hk3gtl.approved.F06.line.1: In front of Herrscher, all that exists is a tiny piece of dust and can reflect starlight.
hk3gtl.approved.F06.line.2: You can go on with these things you've created, but you can't take today as the end of a choice.
hk3gtl.approved.F06.line.3: Ben Herrscher will still look at the guacamole.
hk3gtl.approved.F06.line.4: Now, is the builder willing to continue this unfinished road with your own answers? ☆

hk3gtl.approved.F06A.line.1: Some started with a reactor, some started with an art book, and others stopped on the day the master shuts down the world.

hk3gtl.approved.F09.title: It's time to wake up.

hk3gtl.approved.F09.line.5: It's not like you're leaving here for a while to erase what you built.
hk3gtl.approved.F09.line.6: This is the last suggestion of Herrscher.
