hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.title: IF-01 Nuclear Power, Easy!
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.0: "Nuclear power, easy! So this is how you announced that the large Honkai reactor was inaugurated? Well, that, Ben Herrscher, will keep the tarts for you.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.1: The control room was filled with a first line of light, the plant restored power, and you've been discussing where to build the second one.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.2: As for the operating manual, under a glass for the celebration, there was already a platinum reactor moving. What could be worth a page over? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.3: Then, when one hand touched the wrong place, the cooling condition that was supposed to be confirmed first wasn't confirmed.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.4: You started laughing at the pointers, you said it was a small problem; when the laughs stopped, the alarm had already been ringing for you.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.5: Someone jumped to the console, someone ran for the exit and hung it in the recorder.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.6: The core finally blew up the tatter, and you thought you'd shut the sun down.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.7: The plant is followed by a storage station, followed by the city's expanding energy hub, which drags everything that connects you into flames.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.8: Ben Herrscher didn't even have time to see the last recording of the reactor's name, civilization -- it started with confidence, behind it was all murmurs.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-01.line.9: Nuclear power, easy? Well, I'll put that on the ruins and at least the later will know how sure you were.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.title: IF-02 Infighting
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.0: This dry civilization, not the first to divide the land, is a very small phrase: "The one you use, too? ”☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.1: A steamman can't look down on a man who uses magic, a man who laughs at a man who lays a cable and how to open a warehouse door, enough for them to argue all day.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.2: At first they just argued about their tools, and then what they liked became a flag, and what they didn't like was a crime; they finally didn't have to look at what they were doing.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.3: A man comes out with a new machine, not asking questions, but checking whose side he's on. With whose design? Why do you have to go out with those people? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.4: The bridge was broken because the other side of the bridge had been cut off, because it would have been a very careful distribution of electric cables, even for common heating.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.5: They call every destruction a victory, put the wrecks in the square, wait for their comrades to drink the city a little less each day and celebrate more than the day.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.6: Some people tried to persuade them to fix it together, and they found out on both sides that the man was trying to get a hold of you.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.7: The war lasted for a long time, and every factory could find the man to hate.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.8: When Ben Herrscher looks over here, there's no one left but a few of them, keeping the lights out and continuing to prove that their light is noble.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-02.line.9: Who the hell did you win? Speak louder, Ben Herrscher.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.title: IF-03 The Queen Arrives
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.0: You've been studying in the lab for a long time, and you've finally drawn a conclusion to one of your provocations and sent it to the Queen.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.1: So the sky darkened and there was no clouds, no night screens -- just a figure larger than all your measurements, looking down at this civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.2: You look up, you don't see the highest observation tower in the sky above her head.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.3: The alarms were launched throughout the mainland fleet, shielded. All the weapons that were supposed to last were pushed onto the launch pad at the same moment.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.4: And this time, you did do everything in your power to pull those cannons out of her arm and look at it from the ground as if they were enough to light up the stars of the night sky.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.5: But she's only slightly missed the end of the migraines, and there's not even a trace that deserves to be identified.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.6: "That's it? "The Queen reaches out, and his thumbs and index finger are slowly coming near you to see the shadows of two horizons covering the horizon, coming together from both sides of civilization.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.7: The fleet tried to break out of the finger, and the city sent its last energy into the shield.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.8: Without the towers and ships that you think are sharp enough to make a little crumb from her fingertips.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-03.line.9: Ben Herrscher remembers that civilization you fought for... and let me think, left hand or right hand? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.title: IF-04 Honkai?
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.0: "Honkai? "When you hear the word, it's a rather interesting expression. It's not fear. It's not in the catalogue of studies.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.1: You're going to take another complete technological road, where the ore is torn apart, and the elements are to be re-organised, and the giant machine is to rise up and finally create the heart of the universe.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.2: Later, artificial stars lit you up in front of the factory, talking about energy supply, expansion, and how much more material is needed to move on.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.3: And then, you set out to create dimensions that used to exhaust the entire production line as if it was no longer worth counting.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.4: Ben Herrscher admits that these achievements have not been facilitated by Honkai, and you have also come to places where many civilizations can't even think of names.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.5: But you didn't have a location for Honkai, and you didn't touch it, so you thought the whole road didn't have to answer it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.6: The first thing you saw when Herrscher arrived was that your most proud technocratic shell didn't stop understanding, and the latching didn't hide the principle.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.7: The heart of the universe has been broken, and man-made stars have fallen to the other side of your hands so that you think you've crossed the creative dimension of the finish line, and you can't isolate the ruins from them.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.8: You didn't go far enough, you were nothing but enemies on the map, and you ended up walking into the map.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-04.line.9: It's a shame to be able to deliver this interview so beautifully, but the last one, Herrscher, didn't follow your familiar formula.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.title: IF-05 Magic?
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.0: This leaves Herrscher to spend a little more time on an empty machine bed, without a cable full of ground cables, even the air seems quieter.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.1: You let the flowers gather their strength, then you can direct it to where they need to be supplied.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.2: On the other side, blood drops into the altar and you don't pretend it's an unrequited gift, a price paid and a power gained.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.3: The flow of spirits between the forest lands is carefully guided by you to look after each other's trees, land and homes.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.4: And even more strange voodoo pills, rituals and strangers who seem to be refusing to obey the same rules, yet you find a way to get along.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.5: The wounds are healing, planting the means to transport, guard, travel and wait for a steel factory to give you answers.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.6: Ben Herrscher thought he'd see a bunch of people who only dared to pray to the unknown, and you'd remember it better than many engineers.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.7: When the lights in the city turned on, the garden was still a garden, and the forest was still the strength of the forest that grew in life without crowding it into the corner.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.8: As for whether this will reach the end of the line Ben Herrscher has not yet taken this leaf and kept it long enough to taste it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-05.line.9: I'm just saying that you use these little tricks pretty good enough for me to look at them again.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.title: IF-06 The Everything Box
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.0: The beginning of this branch is when you get a box that says there's nothing left to open, and even the sky is about to be filled with roads inside.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.1: On the left is the factory, on the right is magic, there's a remnant in the ground, and you just learned the first page, and ten new books have been opened.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.2: You want to be a machine? You want to have a garden first? Or can you want to drop the garden and go to another dimension? The door was for you.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.3: Such tolerance is tempting for you to find a force you've never used every day, and every path is like saying, "Come here, something really interesting lies ahead."
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.4: So the warehouse started to pile up with a first half set of rituals, an array of transmission networks, a power-only factory and a backpack for the next launch.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.5: And sometimes you ask, "What is the answer to what?" And the person who does it can't stop opening a new door.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.6: Ben Herrscher saw someone get lost in this maze, and he saw someone pick a corner and slowly build their own city.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.7: The same box, the two endings, it doesn't make a choice for the former, nor does it stop the latter from stopping.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.8: You have so many possibilities, it's a happy thing to say when you say goodbye.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-06.line.9: Pick one for Ben Herrscher, see what's in the box. I saw it; you're going to take something out of it, and it's your turn to answer the question.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.title: IF-07 The Perpetual Assembly Line
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.0: Listen, it's easy to recognize that the sound of the current line has never stopped.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.1: It took you a long time for the ore to go into storage, the raw materials to be sorted out, the formula to line up, and finally let every machine know what it has to do.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.2: Then, one day, you go online, open up the terminal, click on what you need, and then you turn on that newly installed machine.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.3: There's enough raw materials, the power is steady, and there's no blockage on the way, so I can't find anything you need to do.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.4: So you jump from this to that one, and you jump back to this one.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.5: Jumping on the machine, jumping on the machine, jumping on the machine, jumping on the machine, jumping on and off Ben Herrscher thought it was some kind of industrial ritual that had to be done.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.6: When you finally stop, the numbers in the terminals are up a little bit, so we can make another order and tell our people that today's going well.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.7: You're off the water stream and you've kept your promise. There's not even a trace of your busy work on the shell that was just stepped on.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.8: It's only Ben Herrscher who has the ability to hand over such a complex job to the machine.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-07.line.9: What's next order for? If you still have to answer more orders, keep dancing.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.title: IF-08 Incantations and Faith
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.0: In this branch, the first tool to reach far away is a thick book on the cover that tells you real knowledge hasn't started yet.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.1: You'll learn to identify the material, then you'll learn how to placate a pattern.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.2: Then the new magic, the new altar, and the new bond force demand that you learn its own language and not be subdued by a mighty spell.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.3: Some people are good at calling, others study the border and others write countless failures in pages, finally turning a magic trick around their own meanings.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.4: The argument in the city is also good to hear where a line should be drawn, what should be placed in the center.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.5: But by night, a light will shine from every corner of the world on something you've learned with your own hands.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.6: Is this power at any cost? Of course, those who read the last page know that someone who skips a warning will be able to fill this lesson from somewhere else.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.7: Ben Herrscher doesn't require every civilization to put the answer in its shell, so you can read what you call it, and then you're ready to turn the book over.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.8: Just because the spell is long enough, don't think you've understood it between recitation and domination.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-08.line.9: Come on, let's go back to the next page. What do we write? If you're finally leaving your own words, Ben Herrscher might read it in person.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.title: IF-09 The Endless Shore
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.0: There's hardly anyone else in the same place who would have lived behind the horizon for too long.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.1: The first relic appeared in the forest, and you put fire on it, dragged out with a backpack full of stuff and thought you heard the world wave.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.2: Then high towers, dungeons, strange crowds, and the edge of the gate map to another sky, there's always a blank, waiting to be filled with feet.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.3: You learn how to identify the enemy, stay back at the risk, replace the equipment for the next long trip with a location for every wound, and every booty has a history.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.4: Ben Herrscher has seen you arguing around a new map.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.5: I've seen you laugh in the box after a bad war, but all four of you came out alive and had enough fun that night.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.6: Of course, the more the road goes, the more the men leave their greed behind, and the more they chase after the next prize, no one will remember coming back.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.7: This city of leaves may not be built on a single land, but it's between people who still wait for each other and follow them through the wilderness.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.8: When the last map is ready, will you find the next blank? Or will you finally sit down and tell me what you really remember on the way? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-09.line.9: Tell the story, traveler Herrscher's seen too many treasures to allow me to hear it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.title: IF-10 Back to Square One
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.0: Without those complex initials on this branch, you woke up and saw the trees, and you went over there to get some wood.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.1: The wood, the stones, the first decent tool, the sun has not fallen. You've already begun to worry about where you live tonight.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.2: It's hard to see the roof low, the door is wrong, and you're happy when there's an empty sound out there at night.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.3: Then there was a field, a cattle fence, and every time we dug down the road to the mine, you left yourself with a ladder to go home.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.4: You find diamonds, fix your equipment, and move a lot of rocks around the water outside the house, but it's more likely to keep you busy all night.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.5: Someone's going far away, someone's staying at home waiting for someone to come back. There's a line of lights in front of the door, and there's an unsophisticated sign.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.6: You've also challenged the danger of bringing back something to celebrate, but you still have to go back and gather your fields, fix the roofs, and look at the animal that always runs out.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.7: Ben Herrscher was going to ask, after all this, what else are you gonna do?
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.8: There's no such amazing answer as a house that exists because of you. A roadway to where you want to go is enough for one day not to be empty.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-10.line.9: In many worlds that Herrscher has seen, it's never easy to know why he still wants to go home.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.title: IF-11 Arena of the Gods
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.0: There's no one in this branched square with a wall in the center of the building, and it's surrounded by beasts from different worlds.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.1: First, they hit the nails and the flames were frosted, each of them brought their skills to the same site.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.2: Soon after, the defeated party brought in new weapons that were short: no matter how many lives across the street, they should end at the moment of their lives.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.3: And the other side quickly came up with a new promise of refuge: no matter how it attacks on the opposite side, the master should not die.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.4: So the game turned into someone bypassing the shield, somebody cancels death, and someone just wipes out the evidence of the existence of his opponent from this site.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.5: The next round, you can't even erase the two monsters you're still standing around, saying one side must have won, except that the world has yet to admit it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.6: Ben Herrscher, listening for a moment, finally realized that you're not fighting every godly instrument of the Blade, and you want the world to listen to your orders first.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.7: It doesn't matter which one is the most important thing to do when a knife is so beautiful and the enemy is broken.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.8: It's funny if both sides write their own final answer, who are you going to let this debate be declared over? You can't always invite a bigger god.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-11.line.9: Put the instructions in front of Herrscher, who says he'll never lose, usually just doesn't know who he's talking to.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.title: IF-12 Abyss of Numbers
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.0: The monster here had 1,000 lives yesterday, and today a million of you are looking at it with seriousness as if you've finally met the new enemy.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.1: Then someone handed over a new sword to make it hurt, and that's just as much of a digital world as yesterday.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.2: The monster is still coming in the same way, and you're still swinging your swords at the same time.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.3: And then there's a bigger number of numbers coming up further away, and you're told that the real challenge begins there.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.4: The amount of material has increased and the waiting period has been lengthened to add a few more zeroes.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.5: Ben Herrscher, waiting to see the new rules.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.6: Later, the numbers were too long to fit the panels.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.7: If you cover those numbers, do you know what stage you're at? Don't look at the clues. Look at the enemy, look at your sword-shake hand.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.8: They haven't changed. You're the only one who spends time on the same thing, and it's getting harder and harder to put it down.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-12.line.9: Ben Herrscher's patience is endless, but if you want me to commend this as a new experiment, at least take out something other than numbers.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.title: IF-13 The Server of Eternal Night
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.0: After the last man left this leaf, the fire was still burning, the machine was still spinning, and at night it passed through an unmanned square.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.1: He was glad to see a lot of stuff in the warehouse back early in the morning.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.2: Later on, the partners came from different times to say good night to one and the other just pushed the door open; they left the material in their boxes like a greeting for the future.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.3: Ben Herrscher likes the kind of bridge that a man can't finish; the next day it'll be more; without an agreement to wake up at the same time, he'll be able to make the world grow.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.4: But one day, you're starting to wonder if the line will be blocked? How many stocks will be left behind one night later? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.5: I've been thinking about the progress, and I've been thinking about the land that was waiting for you to go back, and it's like I keep asking you to go back on duty.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.6: Some people set the rotation, some learn to stop the machine and others sit in front of the screen, but they can't say they're leaving first.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.7: The world that's been running, it's only responsible for continuing to calculate. It doesn't know who's tired, nor will it decide for anyone.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.8: You can keep a city from sleeping, but if it has to be maintained by the owner, Ben Herrscher, I'm afraid we need to re-examine that design.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-13.line.9: The lights will light up for you, and people can rest off their home and run a guard room where they're not allowed to leave.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.title: IF-14 A Borrowed Dawn
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.0: You're standing on an open ground, and you've got someone else's drawings, a half-transparent contours in front of you.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.1: This piece is here, and it's a little bit of a projection over the wall. It's so far away from the building, it finally grows under its feet.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.2: It's a good way to borrow something you don't have to start with every old mistake, so you can stand where someone else has gone and see what it looks like.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.3: Ben Herrscher didn't intend to make fun of the fact that you could see other people's good things.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.4: Then the terrain went a little bit off, and the entrance needed to be changed to the placards without answering, so you stopped right there, staring at those squares that weren't even perfect.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.5: Someone went back and looked at the lines, and they finally turned this into a proper look for themselves.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.6: So, with the same reference, two different structures, one of which slowly grew up in the mind of its owner, and the other, where it's not easy to keep it as it is.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.7: You can write your place by the door. That doesn't make the wall that you're building short enough to wipe out your signature, or let the understanding grow into your head.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.8: Ben Herrscher wants to see if you can decide where to put the next piece when that semi-transparent contours go out.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-14.line.9: Let's do this, and there's no shame in it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.title: IF-15 The Ship of Theseus
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.0: Ben Herrscher, remember there was a boat that looked at it later. The bow changed. You said the old ones weren't working.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.1: After a while, undersea, masts and sails were replaced.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.2: You change a machine, then you adjust the formula, and then you take down inappropriate rules, and you take out every step alone.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.3: It's too slow to replace the original journey without stopping, so it's faster; it's too easy and harder; a certain road is no longer used, and the entrance is sealed together.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.4: Finally, one day, the man who first came with the drawings got back on board and he knew his sign, but couldn't find his own cabin, or understand the new pass code.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.5: You tell him it's still the same name as the ship. It's on file. Even the original log is in a cabinet.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.6: And he asked, "What's the name of that old piece if you put it back together and park it next to it?" This time, it's been quiet on deck for a long time.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.7: Ben Herrscher, with no intention of counting for you, changing the board, the world must be named after someone who remembers, agrees and walks along.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.8: But if you're heading for another sea, let the people on board know that they can't ask them to recognize what they're looking at by their old names.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-15.line.9: Whose work is this ship now, and where are we going to carry people? The answer to these two questions is whether it's still the same one, and it can be left on its way.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.title: IF-16 The All-in-One Feast
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.0: This box also contains a lot of stuff, but unlike the one before it, the owner seems to have done only one job -- pouring everything that he found into it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.1: There's a few similar metal platinums in the warehouse that have names and uses, but no one has arranged for them to be exchanged and which must be distinguished.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.2: Some shared labels of materials, and the formulas put in the wrong ones; others were supposed to be connected, but they were kept in different drawers.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.3: Biologicals have also been inserted into the overlapping classification rule that it should be protected, another rule that it should be hunted, and the third rule that it is rewritten for.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.4: You're standing there, watching a couple of arrangements and holding on to each other's rights.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.5: Emerging issues are not being combed out, but have been lengthened by a new item on the list and conflict has grown, opening up the world to the most suspenseful thing in the day.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.6: No one's reconnected to the formula, no one's coordinated the source of material, and no one's checking whether a shortcut has bypassed half the journey.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.7: Ben Herrscher, who looked at it for half a day and didn't see the so-called rich road pedestals, saw only a lot of things that were meant to be regulated, forced to block each other in the same doorway.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.8: Bringing a bunch of musicians together, someone has to tell them when it starts and you think that with enough numbers, the noise will turn into symphony.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-16.line.9: This time don't rush into adding something that already exists and can finish it in the same world.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.title: IF-17 The Speedrun Phantom
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.0: The first sound of this branch's work, not a welcome one, is that the timing starts when you've seen the world and you've estimated which step will save us a few seconds.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.1: Which side the tree should be cut, which order the material should be collected, and when the tools are changed, it's luxurious to hesitate here in advance.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.2: The first time you failed, the second time you were late and the third time you found a shorter roadblock, it wasn't surprising to you.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.3: Ben Herrscher, it's a fast-drive hype that people think you're jumping at. Only you know how many times you've missed your feet.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.4: Later, letters along the way were omitted, scenes were omitted, and even a meeting worth stopping was turned into nodes that had to pass as quickly as possible.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.5: Of course you know what you're doing on the timer, reading a letter doesn't make that number even more beautiful.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.6: Until the end of the line, time stops and you stare at it, first silence, then you're allowed to laugh -- a little bit faster.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.7: If that's what you want, Ben Herrscher would like to admit that the proficient is not brought back if anyone asks a story about the road.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.8: Some people take another journey after the record, slowly walking through the familiar path; others are ready for the next clock to be a choice, and they don't have to announce their only game.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-17.line.9: It's a good run. The clock's stopped. Do you want to see what else is next to the finish line? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.title: IF-18 The Silent Archive
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.0: People around here are afraid of forgetting Zippo, so they build archives, keep every trip, every victory, and don't lose pictures of the first shed leaking.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.1: The bookshelf is perfect, the number is correct. Who said what? Which route failed.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.2: Every important day, they say, "We have to keep in mind that we'll have a new record, lock the door, and keep busy with what's ahead of us."
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.3: Ben Herrscher asked a man what was written in the old record, and he told me that he kept all of them.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.4: After a while, the same mistake occurred again, with surprises, arguments, and a new book that was familiar to the archives.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.5: The old book was next door, it wasn't hidden, it didn't lose its name.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.6: They keep laughs, but they don't smell them; they don't read the letters anymore.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.7: It's a complete collection, of course, that tells those who came later that there have been so many things that it doesn't necessarily explain who they changed.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.8: Ben Herrscher, you don't have to stand in front of the old days and turn over a page every once in a while, and let yourself say one more word is better than locking a thousand doors.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-18.line.9: The memory will be safe, and someone will have to see it or what you're building is just a safe house that never receives the owner.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.title: IF-19 The Tyranny of Balance
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.0: There are three words on this city's door: fairness, standards, order, and the passers-by says there should be no need to worry.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.1: It's true that at first there was a deal and a way to argue, the powerful can't just take something from someone else, so you can finally build your own house.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.2: Then standard-setters found that the house was still high and low, that tools were still different, that some people were moving fast, that some methods were better used, and that they weren't perfect enough.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.3: First, they cut down the highest roofs and ask all windows to open in the same position so that from afar, the whole city will no longer show disturbing differences.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.4: When the new tool comes in, the tester doesn't ask what it can solve, just asks if it will make it easier for anyone to do it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.5: Someone tried another route, was told that it was not standard-setting; a proposal was made to revise the standards and was informed that frequent changes were detrimental to order.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.6: Ben Herrscher, looking down on this city, is really pretty enough for everyone to be in a very close position, saying that he doesn't even know what to do.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.7: But when the wind doesn't blow by the size of the street, and you don't have to sign your agreement without a different tool, you realize that even those who built it are being persuaded to leave.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.8: When would the rule of freedom from bullying have been worth keeping, and the rule has become to prevent anyone from taking another step forward? ☆
hk3gtl.approved.IF-19.line.9: Ben Herrscher likes order, but he doesn't need a whole city with a full shell to bring your standards closer. I want to see who it serves.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.title: IF-20 The Unfinished Save
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.0: Every few days, the owner will come back to announce a new plan.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.1: The first day of building a city, the next day trying to dig into the ground, the third day seeing beautiful drawings, decided to fix a tower in the distance.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.2: The material is moved here, it's paved up there, and every place leaves a "go back" arrangement.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.3: Ben Herrscher, walking along those foundations, can see the enthusiasm leaving halfway through the wall, half-lighted, and the stairs are parked in mid-air.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.4: There was no explosion, no enemy, no one to drive you away, but the next thing to look fresher, and suddenly it wasn't worth it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.5: You've come back occasionally to visit, and you're so impressed that you've been thinking about it, and then you've drawn up an empty space next to it, and you're going to start a major project that will be done.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.6: Ben Herrscher has heard so many times about these empty door holes that he seems to have learned to wait and decide whether or not to welcome the master.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.7: If you just want to try it, then you'll make a whole city of yourselves every time, and then you're only going to cash in the first row of diamonds.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.8: Why don't you put that door in a small one, not enough to shake the tree sea, but enough to get the word "complete" to live here for the first time?
hk3gtl.approved.IF-20.line.9: When it's really closed and open, we'll talk about the beginning of a miracle.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.title: IF-21 The Forgotten Heart
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.0: The factory was complete and the line didn't stop, and Ben Herrscher could hardly find a reason to say you were on the wrong road.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.1: But I remember you first came here to build a small town by the river where you could live with your companions.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.2: Then you found out that to make the town easier, you had to have stable materials for material, you built a factory, and you were chasing higher efficiency for the factory.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.3: There's every reason to explain why the original thing should wait and why the new goal must be accomplished first.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.4: For many years now, the river has been filled with a small town full of machines left behind in the old drawings, which were crushed under the box, and the boxes have long gone missing.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.5: Sometimes the partner asks, you answer, and when they stop asking after this stage, you stop thinking about when it's going to be.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.6: Until one day, there was nothing missing from the warehouse and you didn't know what to do when you went online.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.7: You didn't stop, you didn't lose the contest. You just walked too long.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.8: Ben Herrscher can tell you what the next machine is called, but he can't decide for you.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-21.line.9: Go back and take a look. If you still want it, start again from there; if your wish has changed, admit yourself to the new one, and don't let the old pretexts keep you alive.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.title: IF-22 The World That Never Reopened
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.0: The time of this leaf, after a very common mishap, was wrong to use the twilight material, the machine failed to start or a failure took away what had just been brought back.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.1: You've been standing there long enough to think you could have done it tonight.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.2: Then you shut down the world and didn't say goodbye. You just said forget it. I don't want to touch these today.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.3: Today will be tomorrow, tomorrow will be the day that the archives remain in their original position, and the last date to open will not move forward.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.4: Ben Herrscher, of course the place where he went in to see the failure is still there, but what's done next to it hasn't disappeared.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.5: You built that road, and the warehouse was a little bit filled with platinums that were standing silently and didn't know they had been sentenced together at once.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.6: Tired enough to stop, and indeed not like it, or leave Harscher without a leaf that needs to be held in hand.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.7: But if you still like it, you just can't take this one without success.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.8: When you come back, you don't have to take over that puzzle right now.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-22.line.9: It's not entirely up to it to decide what a setback is.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.title: IF-23 The Final Heartbeat
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.0: This branch has been clear from the beginning: life is only this time, you know, and still chooses to walk in.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.1: At first, the night road was so careful, then there were walls in the house, roads outside the wall. You lived in danger for a long time, and you finally got to know your nerve when it stopped.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.2: Many years ago, there was a very early hut on the land that didn't open because every time I passed it, I could recognize myself as being so clumsy.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.3: The accident didn't pick a scene that was worthy of all these years. It was just a slip, a pause, or a danger that wouldn't normally be missed.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.4: You can't arrange for the last word to come to an end.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.5: Ben Herrscher saw you parked there, and the whole thing that didn't go away for years was stuck in a moment as if the world had not really stopped.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.6: I'm not going to call it a lack of effort to build something so long, and simply deny it at that last moment.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.7: You did lose your chance to continue walking in your original capacity.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.8: If you're going to start again, it's a question you have to answer later. Now, you can either feel bad about this journey or you can read it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-23.line.9: The leaves will fall and the builder will be Ben Herrscher, who has seen it grow, will not be able to remove all the pre-spring cynics from his last heartbeat.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.title: IF-24 Life Beyond the World
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.0: This time, no enemy came in and no machine broke down.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.1: The next day there was a job, then things at home, and some lives outside the world that couldn't be done by progress.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.2: You thought you'd be busy, but then the free nights were getting shorter, so short that it would take a little effort to re-think the line.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.3: Before you left last time, you put your tools in a box, and there's nothing strong to say goodbye to keeping them where they're known, just as usual, thinking you'd be back soon.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.4: The archives are still in your memory, and the road to the door is not old because of the date.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.5: Ben Herrscher, who has seen many civilizations fall apart, doesn't want to write that word for you this time.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.6: There are things that have to be fixed, and there are people waiting for you, who can't go around with a new game, and you don't seem weak.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.7: If you come back one day, it's easy to walk around and see what you left behind without chasing anyone.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.8: And if you don't come back, there's no need to apologize for this quiet land.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-24.line.9: Go to Ben Herrscher. You have to spend your whole life on this leaf.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.title: IF-25 After Deletion
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.0: This time, you made your own decision to find the file, stop by a familiar name for a while and then choose to delete it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.1: The tip asks again, "You know what's in it, you know what this button means, and you finally confirm it."
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.2: The name disappeared from the list, and then even the game was removed. It used to open every day, leaving an empty space on the screen.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.3: Ben Herrscher didn't intend to create a single reason. Maybe you're tired of having to say goodbye, maybe you just don't want to leave the trip there anymore.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.4: The walls, the roads and those that are just the last steps of work no longer wait to be loaded with a quiet ending, as if they had occupied so many nights.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.5: If it was a move in anger, regret might come quickly and Herrscher wouldn't pretend that if he said nothing, everything would go back to the way it was.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.6: If that's a good-bye, then you don't have to make up the charges of leaving.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.7: What can be deleted is the world that has been preserved, not everything that's happened, but the way you learn to speak to your peers, not in the same document.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.8: There may be a new beginning, and perhaps there's no need to force yourself to close the door forever in order not to prove that it was worth it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-25.line.9: Ben Herrscher saw that confirmation of how to get out of the door.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.title: IF-26 Creation Needs No Permission
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.speaker: Herrscher of the Void■■■
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.0: Last look at a leaf that doesn't have to apply for material from the warehouse, you reach out your hand, and the diamonds you want are in your hand; lift up, and the sky doesn't ask you to build a machine.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.1: You didn't start with the wood, you didn't prepare a long production line for the first lamp.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.2: The castle can hang in the clouds, the ship can cross the ridge, and the whole river can switch to another arc for what you want.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.3: Some people say it's so easy to come, and there's nothing else to do about it, Herrscher, looking at the empty space, but I think they haven't really thought about what they're building.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.4: The material is no longer in your way, but the sizes, shapes and thoughts still require you to decide for yourself why this window should open here without a formula.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.5: You've tried many times to thin the wall too thick, move the towers away and reset half the sky for a long look.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.6: These changes will not be fully remembered by a list of materials, but when you finally get to the ground and see the finished product, you know it's different from what it was at first.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.7: Ben Herrscher doesn't need you to suffer enough to admit that if you build something beautiful, you can only prove value on a scarce basis and imagine being locked up for too long.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.8: Here, the world doesn't push you to graduate, nor does it have a number that says enough for you to go on, stop, or invite someone else to see it.
hk3gtl.approved.IF-26.line.9: Do it, builder. Let Ben Herrscher see what the sky looks like when you don't have to bow your head for material.
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.open.title: Incoming and opening.
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.open.line.1: I am the last cocoon, the source of Honkai in the solar system.
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.open.line.2: I have witnessed the development of your civilization. You found Honkai and started to understand and use it in your own way.
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.open.line.3: You've had your first trial. The call was in response to that outcome.
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.open.line.4: But the path you have travelled is only the beginning.
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.open.line.5: Now, you can ask me three questions.
I'm the source of Honkai in this solar system. And the power that you have come into contact with.
Honkai is the mechanism for screening civilizations.
The stronger the civilization, the stronger the Honkai. And your growth will continue with that which you have been tested.
Honkai energy fills the room. There is nothing but us here.
4. What should be the way after that?
There is still something in your power that you do not understand. Keep searching along your findings.
5. Credibility of Schicksal, Anti-Entropy and WorldSerpent?
Believe them or not, it's up to you.
I will not make a choice for your civilization.
I can't tell you that answer.
Upgrade your technology and develop your civilization.
It is up to you to ask for the answer.
Are you the owner of Honkai?
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.closing.tit: After the third question, it's a binding.
hk3gtl.approved.first_review.closing.lin: I will give you the knowledge that you deserve to live through this trial.
How to understand and how to use it will still have to be done by you yourselves.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.title: Echo outside calibration
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.speaker: Signal observation records
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.0: The beacon base coordinates calibration log.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.1: This round of calibration has been completed.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.2: The beacon left an additional signal that could not be attributed to the intended calibration results.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.3: Initially, it was much like an undiscovered interference. It continues to be seen along the record, where seemingly chaotic changes are accompanied by some interrelated segments. They do not point to a position that can already be identified, but they are not enough to simply be deleted as noise.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.4: It is not yet possible to explain its origin.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.5: The beacon completed its original work and brought back an issue that was not intended to be sought.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.6: Please keep a complete record of this round. The rush to cover calibration data would deprive the next study of its original basis. The anomaly remains in the observation records; it does not constitute a route accessible, nor does it mean that a destination capable of sending personnel or extracting devices has been identified.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.7: Instead of arranging a train now, it would be better to show it first to researchers at the Institute for Material Reconstruction. This anomaly is a stand-alone subject to determine at which point the existing positioning method has lost its interpretation of the signal.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.8: If the record does point in the direction of new observations, what we need next will be a facility dedicated to continuous observation. Its work is the result of making these fragments increasingly understandable.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.9: As to what exactly is there, this calibration cannot answer.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.10: We were just trying to make sure that the beacon could see.
hk3gtl.approved.observation.QOM.line.11: Now what needs to be clarified is what it sees.

hk3gtl.event.eg493.condition: Actively shut down the phone after 3 minutes of first opening of notes; normal reading is not required to hang up
hk3gtl.narrative.e_eg_494.title: It's not daily.
hk3gtl.event.eg494: There's no consecutive log-in reward waiting for you, only the message that was left.
hk3gtl.event.eg494.condition: For the first time in three consecutive days of reality, we read a notice.
hk3gtl.narrative.e_eg_495.title: And the criteria are clear.
hk3gtl.event.eg495: When the rules were clear, there was finally room for debate to look at together.
hk3gtl.event.eg495.condition: I kept a note of at least three specific acceptances.
hk3gtl.narrative.e_eg_496.title: A comparison of peace
hk3gtl.event.eg496: They can live in the same box. Different designs don't have to be erased from each other.
hk3gtl.event.eg496.condition: I put two different models of the same-use items into containers without fighting.
hk3gtl.narrative.e_eg_497.title: Create a piece first.
hk3gtl.event.eg497: What do you want first at this moment when there is no resource threshold?
hk3gtl.event.eg497.condition: I put the first ordinary building block in a creation mode; only collection partitions were created
hk3gtl.narrative.e_eg_498.title: Open it after the pause.
hk3gtl.event.eg498: You're back. The last record, this time, could be a clue.
hk3gtl.event.eg498.condition: The real experiment, which I paid for and had advanced, was successfully re-logged in after being suspended because of lack of capacity, and the same subject description of the experiment was reopened.
hk3gtl.narrative.e_eg_499.title: Priority of life
hk3gtl.event.eg499: This one can wait. The life you have to face doesn't have to be behind the progress bar.
hk3gtl.event.eg499.condition: I marked a note as the next time I quit my cell phone.
hk3gtl.narrative.e_eg_500.title: After page 500.
hk3gtl.event.eg500: Page 500 is not the end. This catalogue can continue to grow up, and you don't have to miss the outside world in order to fill it.
hk3gtl.event.eg500.condition: After the discovery of at least one egg, this description is read in the collection catalogue and the active collection is completed.

hk3gtl.phone.instructions.title: Instructions
hk3gtl.phone.instructions.cost.title: Research costs
hk3gtl.phone.instructions.cost.body:
Research costs

A topic starts from real evidence, then accepts either research points or the listed materials. The server checks institute grade, experiments, prerequisites, completed records and running jobs.

Research points come from the research computer work ledger. Material payment takes real items from the payer inventory and commits them through the payment journal. Once started, the institute separately consumes the topic EU/t and advances while powered.

S01 has no gaze pressure. From S02 onward, the confirmed composite pressure and suppression formulas affect speed and additional materials; item sensitivity applies individually and additional amounts round upward. Use the topic screen for the exact price, time, EU/t and materials.

Gold credit
This page is available with any usable phone. Holding gtceu:gold_credit while opening it only records an optional collection. It is not research currency, is not exchanged or consumed, and cannot replace experiments, materials, points, energy or real completion receipts.

hk3gtl.phone.instructions.reactor.title: Reactor safety
hk3gtl.phone.instructions.reactor.body:
Reactor operation

This page covers I19 small, I20 medium, I21 large and I22 ultimate Honkai reactors. Reading does not start a machine or grant research. Operation requires the real structure, recipe, research and output conditions.

Fuel grades and cooling
Standard rods and non-concentrated carriers are low-grade fuels. They accept water, distilled water, grade 8 purified water, grade 16 purified water or Honkai industrial coolant. Concentrated rods and concentrated carriers are high-grade fuels and accept only Honkai industrial coolant. Fuel tooltips and the core interface show cooling requirements.

Supply coolant through fluid inputs. The core circulates coolant every 20 ticks independently of fuel recipes. Industrial coolant has priority, followed by water, distilled water, grade 8 and grade 16 purified water. Each cycle uses one medium that can be fully supplied and whose hot output fits. Usage follows accumulated heat; a cold core consumes no coolant. Water cooling outputs steam; industrial coolant outputs hot Honkai industrial coolant. Blocked hot-fluid outputs prevent cooling and allow heat to keep accumulating. Assemblies of 4, 8 or 16 inherit their parent fuel grade; power, heat and cooling capacity scale by 4, 8 or 16. Burn duration and heat limit do not increase.

Heat and shutdown
The core displays accumulated heat, its heat limit and cooling capacity. An unfinished batch continues generating heat when suspended, short of coolant or blocked at its outputs. Suspension does not replace cooling. Reaching the heat limit melts down and destroys the controller. A new batch requires heat below 10% of the current limit. This page offers no remote machine switch.

Only continuous reading of the full text records the reader action. Reading does not replace production or research achievements.

hk3gtl.guide.civilization.c5.description: Civilization begins to understand and influence the survival of worlds.
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-cee.title: What Makes a Wonder
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-cee.description: Research engineering evaluation methods that can demonstrate whether a wonder truly works.
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-hvi.title: A Home for the Journey
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-hvi.description: Research replica Hyperion systems integration and unite the hull with its working systems.
hk3gtl.guide.civilization.c6.title: C6 · Civilization Wonders
hk3gtl.guide.civilization.c6.description: The first wonder has produced a genuine engineering achievement.
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-cle.title: Understand What You Built
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-cle.description: Develop the Civilization Cognition Dome and study how your achievements coexist.
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-cav.title: Let Achievements Bear Witness
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-cav.description: Cross-validate civilization achievements so that knowledge and working engineering support each other.
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-taa.title: The Final Structure
hk3gtl.guide.research.rn-taa.description: Research the Tree Audience Architecture and prepare a place for the final meeting.
hk3gtl.guide.civilization.c7.title: C7 · Cognition and Judgment Readiness
hk3gtl.guide.civilization.c7.description: Knowledge and engineering form a complete record; the final meeting remains personal.
hk3gtl.guide.finale.title: The Name a Civilization Leaves
hk3gtl.guide.finale.description: The quest book records a teammate's completed final meeting; personal graduation still requires your own experience.
hk3gtl.machine.i01_2_honkai_collection_t: Retains first-stage collection processes and adds solid-state Honkai collection.
Produces Honkai crystal seeds, impurities and hot coolant.
hk3gtl.machine.i01_3_honkai_collection_t: Retains the first two stages of collection and adds gaseous Honkai collection.
Produces gaseous Honkai energy, spent filters and hot coolant.
hk3gtl.machine.i01_4_honkai_collection_t: Retains the first three stages of collection and adds energy-state Honkai collection.
Produces compressed Honkai cores, spent filters and hot coolant.
hk3gtl.machine.soulium_polymerization_di: Presses Soulium feedstock and advanced composites into blanks.
Supports swarf repolymerization, hot-press densification, and multi-axis co-curing.
Provide separate outputs for liquid residue and solid waste.
hk3gtl.machine.soulium_reconstruction_an: Reconstructs, anneals, and ages Soulium and advanced composites.
Supports seeded directional growth, stress relief, and composite conditioning.
Supply the required stabilizing medium and coolant; remove spent medium and hot coolant.
hk3gtl.machine.soulium_precision_process: Machines Soulium and advanced materials into plates, rods, rings, foils, fine wires, and frames.
Produces circuit intermediates, precision components, and machine hulls.
Supports scrap recovery, component disassembly, and finish machining.
hk3gtl.machine.honkai_fuel_concentration: Supply the required stabilizing medium and coolant; reprocess the hot coolant.
hk3gtl.machine.honkai_fuel_rod_encapsula: Encapsulates Honkai fuel or charged carriers into fuel rods.
Uses rod casings and encapsulation parts to supply Honkai reactors.
Encapsulation requires cooling; discharge hot coolant through a fluid output hatch.
Runs one fuel batch at a time; accepts single, quad, octal, and 16-rod fuel bundles.
Sends EU to the bound player's wireless grid and credits Honkai energy as the fuel burns.
Continuously cool the core and discharge heated fluid; high-grade fuels require industrial Honkai coolant. Overheating causes a meltdown and explosion.
hk3gtl.machine.i20_medium_honkai_reactor: Runs one fuel batch at a time; accepts single, quad, octal, and 16-rod fuel bundles.
Sends EU to the bound player's wireless grid and credits Honkai energy as the fuel burns.
Continuously cool the core and discharge heated fluid; high-grade fuels require industrial Honkai coolant. Overheating causes a meltdown and explosion.
Runs one fuel batch at a time; accepts single, quad, octal, and 16-rod fuel bundles.
Sends EU to the bound player's wireless grid and credits Honkai energy as the fuel burns.
Continuously cool the core and discharge heated fluid; high-grade fuels require industrial Honkai coolant. Overheating causes a meltdown and explosion.
hk3gtl.machine.i22_ultimate_honkai_react: Runs one fuel batch at a time; accepts single, quad, octal, and 16-rod fuel bundles.
Sends EU to the bound player's wireless grid and credits Honkai energy as the fuel burns.
Continuously cool the core and discharge heated fluid; high-grade fuels require industrial Honkai coolant. Overheating causes a meltdown and explosion.
hk3gtl.machine.i23_honkai_phase_transiti: Converts gaseous Honkai energy into EU using process gas filters.
Runs one batch at a time; overclocking does not shorten its duration.
Supply coolant and remove depleted filters, hot exhaust, and hot coolant.
hk3gtl.machine.i24_quantum_anomaly_obser: Observes quantum anomalies using spatial probes and reference samples.
Produces world-model carriers from the observations.
Also performs preliminary experiments for world-bubble coordinate analysis.
hk3gtl.machine.i25_world_bubble_coordina: Analyzes coordinates, produces located world bubbles, and records team routes.
Uses spatial probes and Soulium data substrates to make spatial calibration modules.
Mining and capture operations require an analyzed target.
hk3gtl.machine.i26_world_bubble_unmanned: Insert a located world bubble to mine an available target from your team's routes.
Each batch consumes one located bubble. Each target can be mined once, and distinct targets can be mined in parallel.
Probes wear out; recover worn probes and dismantling scrap.
hk3gtl.machine.i27_world_bubble_capture_: Captures and seals real world bubbles analyzed by the team.
Requires an empty containment vessel, Soulium anchors, and containment medium.
Capture consumes filters and produces hot coolant.
hk3gtl.machine.i28_world_bubble_terminat: Terminates and reclaims real world bubbles captured by the team.
Consumes a termination charge and coolant to recover matter and vessel remnants.
A terminated target cannot be mined or captured again.
hk3gtl.machine.i29_simulated_world_bubbl: Constructs simulated world bubbles from world-matter seeds and industrial materials.
Requires an imitation Binding core and world-bubble containment medium.
The output is unstable and must be processed in a stabilizer.
hk3gtl.machine.i30_simulated_world_bubbl: Stabilizes unstable simulated world bubbles constructed by the team.
Consumes Soulium anchors, world-stabilization medium, and coolant.
Stabilized simulated world bubbles can undergo termination and reclamation.
hk3gtl.machine.i31_simulated_world_bubbl: Terminates stabilized simulated world bubbles to recover world-matter seeds.
Consumes a termination charge and coolant, leaving vessel remnants.
This machine processes simulated world bubbles only.
hk3gtl.machine.i32_relic_technology_reve: Analyzes relic technology and cross-world samples to produce reverse-engineering samples.
Interprets and copies known blueprints and performs related research experiments.
Supports multi-domain analysis, finite computation, and conflicting-sample review.
hk3gtl.machine.i33_imitation_divine_key_: Assembles imitation Divine Keys, housings, and related components.
Produces spatial calibration modules, world-bubble containment vessels, and termination charges.
Performs engineering experiments involving imitation cores and Divine Keys.
hk3gtl.machine.i34_imaginary_tree_observ: Observes the Imaginary Tree using spatial probes and Soulium data substrates.
The observation display follows the structure and operating state.
hk3gtl.machine.i35_imaginary_space_ancho: Checks Soulium anchor components and spatial calibration modules.
Checks consume stabilizing medium; components and modules are returned.
Performs Imaginary-space anchoring research and process verification.
hk3gtl.machine.i36_honkai_reality_stabil: With continuous MAX-tier power, suppresses Gaze by 50% within 64 blocks.
With the enhancement research and an imitation Oath of Judah, provides 75% suppression within 128 blocks at QSV-tier power.
The enhancement module is not consumed; insufficient power immediately stops suppression.
hk3gtl.machine.i37_world_maintenance_tri: Runs world-maintenance experiments using anchors, controlled nanoswarms, and Soulium plates.
Consumes world-stabilization medium to produce world-maintenance engineering samples.
Samples are used in later research and civilization engineering.
hk3gtl.machine.i38_imaginary_energy_rect: Rectifies gaseous Honkai energy or compressed Honkai cores.
Consumes filters and coolant to separate exhaust and inactive residue.
Bind a player before operation and provide outputs for waste streams.
hk3gtl.machine.i39_unmanned_cross_bounda: Processes spatial probes, Soulium data substrates, and circuit encapsulation parts.
Uses stable transport medium and solder to produce spatial calibration modules.
Supplies calibration components for spatial-route research and equipment.
hk3gtl.machine.i40_civilization_wonder_m: Synthesizes energy-conducting, binding, reconstruction, and cognition wonder composites.
Supplies primary materials for prefabricated wonder components.
Provide separate outputs for offcuts and spent world-stabilization medium.
hk3gtl.machine.i41_civilization_energy_d: Right-click to open energy dispatch; sneak-right-click to open the process interface.
Register your machine coordinates to enable or pause machines manually and create handover orders.
The process interface produces polarized electromagnetic materials.
hk3gtl.machine.i42_wonder_component_pref: Prefabricates large engineering components from the four wonder composites.
Components are used in civilization-wonder assembly.
Also produces the Origin: Stellar Concerto Court master controller.
hk3gtl.machine.i43_civilization_engineer: Performs joint civilization-engineering experiments and cross-system interface analysis.
Reviews computation results and conflicting samples and verifies cross-machine orders.
Records completed engineering work for research and acceptance.
hk3gtl.machine.i44_imitation_thousand_re: Calibrates spatial modules and verifies enhanced beacon signals.
Spatial modules and calibration tooling are returned.
Used in the Cosmic Juggernaut imitation project and later beacon research.
hk3gtl.machine.i45_imitation_thousand_re: Makes navigation modules from spatial calibration modules, Soulium data substrates, and circuit encapsulation parts.
Requires stable transport medium and solder.
The resulting imitation Hyperion navigation modules are used in later assembly.
hk3gtl.machine.controller.structure_unav: This structure cannot currently form or operate.
hk3gtl.machine.w01_origin_stellar_concer: Processes data substrates, cognitive materials and wonder components into civilization cooperation archives.
Also produces reconstruction rule carriers, lithography masks and calibration samples.
hk3gtl.machine.omnia_autonomous_industri: Processes nano-building units and reconstruction materials into autonomous fabrication matrices.
Also manufactures nano-building units, controlled nanoswarms and assembly components.
Processes soulium anchor components and spatial calibration modules into imaginary anchor matrices.
Also produces spatial probes and world-bubble vessels; supply the process media required by each recipe.
hk3gtl.machine.w04_thunder_superconducti: Processes conducting and confinement composites into superconducting polarization matrices and polarized electromagnetic materials.
hk3gtl.machine.w05_ideal_fluid_circulati: Processes hot coolant and transport medium into ideal-flow heat-exchange matrices.
Regenerates coolant and stabilization medium with losses; reserve output space for waste fluids.
hk3gtl.machine.w06_cryogenic_condensed_f: Processes confinement and reconstruction composites into cryogenic condensation matrices and condensed cryogenic materials.
Matrix production requires Honkai coolant; also processes advanced interconnects and ceramic materials.
View the complete structure in the recipe viewer.
hk3gtl.machine.w07_matter_regeneration_a: Recycles composite offcuts, nano-assembly scrap and spent solvent into matter regeneration matrices.
Recovers soulium substrates and selected composites with losses and residual waste.
Dimensions: 485×1279×330 (W×D×H). The controller faces outward on the central bow deck; other structure blocks accept valid ports.
hk3gtl.machine.w08_stellar_casting_furna: Casts high-dimensional composites into stellar forging matrices and extreme casting materials.
Also processes pump-housing blanks, casting molds and advanced materials; supply coolant as required by each recipe.
hk3gtl.machine.w09_civilization_consensu: Combines cognitive materials, soulium data substrates and civilization archives into civilization consensus archives.
Produces civilization cross-validation reports that combine results from multiple wonder projects.
hk3gtl.machine.w10_gravitational_singula: Processes confinement composites, extreme casting materials and condensed cryogenic materials into gravitational singularity matrices.
Also processes civilization singularities and dense materials; matrix production consumes world stabilization medium.
hk3gtl.machine.w12_global_energy_constra: Processes confinement and conducting composites into global energy constraint matrices.
Also processes encapsulation parts and world-bubble vessels; matrix production consumes bubble confinement medium.
hk3gtl.machine.w13_self_computing_resear: Processes cognitive materials and soulium data substrates into bounded research models.
Switches between manufacturing and dedicated research modes; unfinished research retains its progress.
hk3gtl.machine.w14_world_bubble_recurren: Processes stable simulated world bubbles and world-model carriers into civilization cycle models.
Handles the construction, stabilization and retirement of simulated world bubbles; reserve space for outputs.
Dimensions: 1761×1719×331 (W×D×H). The controller faces outward at the front central entrance; other structure blocks accept valid ports.
hk3gtl.machine.w15_tree_sea_audience_thr: Combines the outputs of fourteen wonders, a civilization cross-validation report and ship engineering archives into a Tree-and-Sea audience credential.
Credential production requires all eight CEV electromechanical component types; also processes final-stage materials and civilization components.
Tree-Sea book dimensions: 1101×878×210 (W×D×H). The controller faces south on the front spine face and is reached by flight; other structure blocks accept valid ports.
hk3gtl.research.computer.tooltip.circuit: Insert one MAX-tier or higher circuit. The circuit is not consumed.
hk3gtl.research.computer.tooltip.rate: A MAX circuit produces 1 research point every 200 operating ticks. Higher-tier circuits increase the rate.
hk3gtl.research.computer.tooltip.power: Requires MAX power. Binds to the placing player and credits that player with research points.
hk3gtl.research.lab.tooltip.payment: Choose research points or materials as the research payment, and complete the required experiments.
hk3gtl.research.lab.tooltip.supply: Materials are taken from the operating player's inventory. Research power is supplied through the structure's energy hatches.
hk3gtl.research.lab.tooltip.pressure: Higher Gaze reduces research speed and increases the consumption of some materials.
hk3gtl.nexus.tooltip.owner: Binds to the placing player. Nexuses owned by the same player can link wirelessly across dimensions.
hk3gtl.nexus.tooltip.management: Install storage cells and patterns in the controller to manage inventory and production orders.
hk3gtl.hyperion.tooltip: Processes hull components, navigation modules, and bridge modules in shipboard engineering.
hk3gtl.hyperion.tooltip.output: Produces ship engineering archives. Heated coolant must be recovered and processed.
hk3gtl.recipe.world_mining.route: Consumes 1 bubble and selects an unmined target from your team's routes
hk3gtl.recipe.world_mining.relic: First Void Archives on team run #5
hk3gtl.config.ae.nexus_planner.comment: When enabled, an online Nexus on the same network plans new requests first. When disabled, AE or GTL Core plans regular requests, and the Nexus can still execute jobs and receive outputs as a crafting CPU. Nexus previews and new auto-restock orders are paused.
hk3gtl.config.research.enabled.comment: Turn this off to disable research institutes, point production and new experiments. Recipes bypass research requirements, and JEI hides all research institute tiers.
hk3gtl.config.height.new_world_mode.comm: Choose which new saves use extended build height. Saves keep the height assigned when they are created.
hk3gtl.config.height.top_exclusive.comme: Enter a multiple of 16 from 528 to 2032. The highest buildable Y is one block below this value (2031 if set to 2032). Applies to new worlds and upward upgrades of existing contracts.
hk3gtl.config.height.existing_worlds.com: Add the exact folder name of a save to upgrade in each entry. Changes apply when you fully reopen that save.
hk3gtl.config.farview.enabled.comment: Shows HK3GTL structures beyond chunk view distance. Turn it off to reduce GPU memory use.
hk3gtl.config.farview.distance.comment: Controls how many blocks away structures remain visible. Chunk view distance and simulation distance use the existing game settings.
hk3gtl.config.farview.gpu_mib.comment: Limits GPU memory for distant structure vertices. When space runs out, nearer geometry takes priority.
hk3gtl.config.phone.right_side.comment: On places notifications on the right, and off places them on the left. A custom horizontal position takes precedence.
hk3gtl.config.phone.horizontal_margin.co: Distance from the selected side of the screen in GUI pixels. Used when the horizontal position is negative.
hk3gtl.config.phone.top.comment: Distance from the top of the screen in GUI pixels. Used when the vertical position is negative.
hk3gtl.config.phone.scale.comment: Adjusts the notification size. Set it to 1 for normal size or 1.5 for 150%.
hk3gtl.config.phone.phone_size.comment: Changes how large the phone interface is in the window. Higher values make it larger.
hk3gtl.config.phone.sound.comment: Play a soft sound when a new notification appears.
hk3gtl.config.phone.chatter.comment: When disabled, non-critical chatter stays in the inbox without a popup.
hk3gtl.config.phone.do_not_disturb.comme: Silences phone notifications while messages continue to arrive in the inbox.
hk3gtl.config.phone.position_x.comment: Set to 0 for the far left or 1 for the far right. Set to -1 to use the selected side and side margin.
hk3gtl.config.phone.position_y.comment: Set to 0 for the top or 1 for the bottom. Set to -1 to use the top offset.
hk3gtl.config.phone.app_order.comment: Phone icons follow this list. You can also drag icons on the phone home screen to rearrange them.
hk3gtl.config.phone.gaze_x.comment: Set to 0 for the far left or 1 for the far right. Set to -1 for the default left offset.
hk3gtl.config.phone.gaze_y.comment: Set to 0 for the top or 1 for the bottom. Set to -1 for the default top offset.
hk3gtl.config.phone.gaze_scale.comment: Resizes the on-screen Finality Gaze panel. Set it to 1 for normal size.
